# Alibaba Cloud Apsara Stack v3.18.6-2607 Apsara Uni-manager Developer Guide 20260901

## Preparations

### Obtain the information and

**endpoint of an API operation**

To call an API operation by using an SDK, you must obtain the information about the API operation, including the service code, API operation name, and API version.

**Background information**

The information on the API directory page of the Apsara Uni-manager Management Console is for reference only. For more information about how to call API operations, see the developer guides of cloud services. If the information on the API directory page is different from that in the developer guide of a cloud service, the information in the developer guide prevails.

**Procedure**

1. Log on to the Apsara Uni-manager Management Console.
2. In the top navigation bar, choose **Products** > **Development Tools** > **API & SDK** >
**OpenAPI Explorer**.
3. On the **OpenAPI Explorer** page, choose **API Integration** > **API Debugging** in the top
navigation bar.
4. In the upper-left corner, move the pointer over the More icon and then select the cloud
service whose API operation you want to call.
5. Select an API version from the **Version** drop-down list.
6. In the API operation list, you can view all API operations of the current version.
7. Click the API operation that you want to call. Obtain the endpoint from the Endpoint
parameter on the Parameter tab.

### Obtain AccessKey credentials

AccessKey credentials are assigned by Resource Access Management (RAM) or Security Token Service (STS). You can use one of the preceding types of AccessKey credentials for authentication when you call API operations.

**Background information**

An AccessKey pair is used to verify the identity of a request sender based on symmetric encryption. An AccessKey pair consists of an AccessKey ID and an AccessKey secret. The AccessKey ID is used to identify a user. The AccessKey secret is used to encrypt the signature string. AccessKey credentials can be assigned by RAM or STS: An AccessKey pair that is assigned by RAM to a third party consists of an AccessKey ID and an AccessKey secret. An AccessKey 3-tuple that is assigned by STS to a third party consists of an AccessKey ID, an AccessKey secret, and a security token.

**Obtain an AccessKey pair**

The Apsara Uni-manager Management Console provides two types of AccessKey pairs: those for personal accounts and those for organization accounts. We recommend that you use AccessKey pairs for personal accounts to call the API operations of the Apsara Uni-manager Management Console and cloud services.

**Note**

Only operations administrators and level-1 organization administrators can obtain AccessKey pairs for organization accounts.

**Obtain the AccessKey pair of a personal account**

To use AccessKey pairs for personal accounts, you must configure the header parameters that are described in the following table for access control. Otherwise, an error that indicates insufficient permissions may occur.

| Parameter | Description |
|---|---|
| x-acs-regionid | The ID of the region to which the instance that you want to access belongs. Example: cn- qingdao-****-****. |
| x-acs-organizationid | The ID of the organization to which the instance that you want to access belongs. For information about how to obtain the ID, see the "Obtain an organization ID" section of the Obtain the values of common request headers topic. |
| x-acs-resourcegroupid | The ID of the resource set to which the instance that you want to access belongs. For information about how to obtain the ID, see the "Obtain a resource set ID" section of the Obtain the values of common request headers topic. |
| x-acs-instanceid | The ID of the instance that you want to access. For example, you can view the ID of an Elastic Compute Service (ECS) instance in the ECS instance list. |

1. Log on to the Apsara Uni-manager Management Console.
2. In the upper-right corner of the homepage, click the profile picture and then click **User**
**Information**.
3. In the **AccessKey Pair** section, view the AccessKey pair of the personal account.

**Note**

The AccessKey pair provides full access to cloud resources within your Alibaba Cloud account. You must keep the AccessKey pair confidential.

**Obtain the AccessKey pair of an organization**

**Warning**

The AccessKey pair of a personal account is managed by the permission system of the Apsara Uni-manager Management Console. If you need to obtain the AccessKey pair of an organization, make sure that your operation is allowed by an administrator. This ensures security.
1. Log on to the Apsara Uni-manager Management Console as an administrator.
2. In the top navigation bar, click **Enterprise**.
3. In the left-side navigation pane, choose **Resources > Organizations**.
4. In the organization list, click the name of the level-1 organization whose AccessKey pair you
want to obtain.
5. On the right side of the page that appears, click **Management AccessKey**.
6. In the dialog box that appears, view the AccessKey pair of the organization.

i. Log on to the Apsara Infrastructure Management console. ii. In the left-side navigation pane, click **Project & Cluster O&M**. iii. In the **Products | Cluster** search box, enter **ascm-A**. iv. Find the cluster and click **Cluster Details** in the **Actions** column. v. On the cluster details page, click the **Desired State Configuration** tab. vi. In the list of files displayed on the left, click **kv.conf**. Then, click **Show Content** on the right. Press Ctrl+F and search for `region` and `internet-domain` to obtain their values.

```xml
    // Create and initialize a DefaultAcsClient instance.

<yourAccessKeyID>", "<yourAccessKeySecret>");

    clientConfig.setIgnoreSSLCerts(true);
    clientConfig.setProtocolType(ProtocolType.HTTPS);
```

```java
private static String callAssumeRole(IAcsClient client) {
    CommonRequest request = new CommonRequest();
    // Replace "sts.aliyuns.com" with the endpoint of STS. The format of an endpoint
is sts-vpc.${global:region}.${global:internet-domain}.
    request.setSysDomain("<sts.aliyuns.com>");
    request.setSysProduct("Sts");
    request.setSysAction("AssumeRole");
    request.setSysVersion("2015-04-01");
    request.setSysMethod(MethodType.POST);
    request.setHttpContentType(FormatType.FORM);
    // The name of the role session. You can specify this parameter based on your bus
iness requirements. This parameter is usually set to the identity of the user who cal ls the API operation, such as the username. Replace "<yourRoleSessionName>" with your custom value.
    request.putQueryParameter("RoleSessionName", "<yourRoleSessionName>");
    // The ARN of the RAM role. This role is a RAM role whose trusted entity is an AS
CM user. Replace "<yourRoleArn>" with the actual RAM role obtained in the first step.
    request.putQueryParameter("RoleArn", "<yourRoleArn>");
    try {
        CommonResponse response = client.getCommonResponse(request);
        return response.getData();
    } catch (ServerException e) {
        System.out.println(e.getErrCode());
        System.out.println(e.getErrMsg());
    } catch (ClientException e) {
        System.out.println(e.getErrCode());
        System.out.println(e.getErrMsg());
```

### Obtain the values of common

**request headers**

In Apsara Stack, you must specify multiple common request headers to call API operations. Then, common response parameters are returned in the results.

**Common request parameters**

You must specify the common request parameters in the code to call API operations in Apsara Stack. For example, in the Java software development kit (SDK) call `request.putHeadParameter("x-` `acs-resourcegroupid", "<yourResourceGroupID>")` , you must replace `<yourResourceGroupID>` with the actual resource group ID.

| Name | Description |
|---|---|
| x-acs-regionid | The ID of the region in which the instance resource on which you want to perform operations resides. For more information, see the Obtain a region ID section of this topic. |
| x-acs- organizationid | The ID of the organization to which the instance resource on which you want to perform operations belongs. For more information, see the Obtain an organization ID section of this topic. |
| x-acs- organization-uuid | The UUID of the organization to which the instance resource belongs. For more information, see Obtain an organization UUID. |
| x-acs- resourcegroupid | The ID of the resource set to which the instance resource on which you want to perform operations belongs. For more information, see the Obtain a resource set ID section of this topic. |
| x-acs- resourcegroup- uuid | The UUID of the resource group to which the instance resource belongs. For more information, see Obtain a resource group UUID. |
| x-acs-roleid | The ID of the role for the operation. For more information, seeO btain a role ID. |
| x-acs-role-uuid | The UUID of the role for the operation. For more information, seeO btain a role UUID. |
| x-acs-instanceid | The ID of the instance to which the resource on which you want to perform operations belongs. For more information, see the Obtain an instance ID section of this topic. |

|   | Note For organization, resource group, and role parameters, you can pass an ID, such as 1, 2, or 3, or a UUID, such as org-xxx, rs-xxx, or ar-xxx. If you pass both an ID and a UUID for the same parameter, the UUID takes precedence. If the specified UUID does not exist, an error is reported. When you call the APIs of other cloud products, you must add the organization ID using the x-acs-organizationid or x-acs-organization-uuid header parameter. Otherwise, the call fails and a permission error is returned. When you call the APIs of other cloud products, you must add the resource group ID using the x-acs-resourcegroupid or x-acs-resourcegroup-uuid header parameter. This specifies the organization and resource group of the resource, which lets you perform isolated queries for instance resources. If you do not specify a resource group ID using x-acs-resourcegroupid or x-acs-resourcegroup- uuid , the default resource group of the user's organization is used. |
|---|---|
|   | uuid |

**Obtain a region ID**

You can view the region IDs of resources in the Apsara Uni-manager Management Console.
1. Log on to the Apsara Uni-manager Management Console as an administrator.
2. In the top navigation bar, click **Enterprise**.
3. In the navigation pane on the left, choose **Resources** > **Regions**.
4. On the Regions page, find the organization that you want to view and click its name in the
organization tree.
5. In the **Regions** list, obtain the region ID from the **Region Name** column.

**Obtain an organization ID**

You must call an API operation to obtain the ID of an organization. You can obtain the organization ID using the online debugging feature in the Apsara Uni-manager Management Console.
1. Log on to the Apsara Uni-manager Management Console as an administrator.
2. In the top navigation bar, choose **Products** > **Development Tools** > **API & SDK** >
**OpenAPI Explorer**.
3. On the **OpenAPI Explorer** page, choose **API Integration** > **API Debugging** in the top
navigation bar.
4. Move the pointer over the
icon and choose **Platform** > **Apsara Uni-manager**. Select
**2019-05-10** from the **Version** drop-down list.
5. In the text box, enter `GetOrganizationList` to debug the API online. For the name
parameter, enter the target organization name and initiate the call. After the call succeeds, view the value of the **id** parameter in the **Call Result** section. This value is the organization ID. For more information, see GetOrganizationList.

**Obtain an organization UUID**

You can view the organization UUID of a resource in the Apsara Uni-manager Management Console.

**Management**.
4. In the organization chart on the left, click the organization name.

You must call an API operation to obtain the ID of a resource set. You can obtain the resource set ID using the online debugging feature in the Apsara Uni-manager Management Console.

view the value of the **id** parameter in the **Call Result** section. This value is the resource group ID. For more information, see ListResourceGroup.

**Obtain a resource group UUID**

You can view the resource group UUID of a resource in the Apsara Uni-manager Management Console.
1. Log on to the Apsara Uni-manager Management Console as an administrator.
2. In the top menu bar, click **Enterprise**.
3. In the navigation pane on the left, choose **Resource Management** > **Resource Group**
**Management**.
4. In the resource group list, locate the ID of the desired resource group. This value is the
resource group UUID.

**Obtain a role ID**

1. Log on to the Apsara Uni-manager Management Console as an administrator.
2. In the top menu bar, choose **Products** > **Developer Tools** > **API And Tools** >
**Developer Portal**.
3. On the **Developer Portal** page, choose **API Integration** > **API Debugging**.
4. Click the
icon, choose **Cloud Platform** > **Unified Cloud Management Platform**, and set **Version** to **2019-05-10**.

**Obtain a role UUID**

You can view the role UUID in the Apsara Uni-manager Management Console.
1. Log on to the Apsara Uni-manager Management Console as an administrator.
2. In the top menu bar, click **Enterprise**.
3. In the navigation pane on the left, choose **Permission Management** > **Role**
**Authorization**.
4. In the role list, locate the ID of the desired role. This value is the role UUID.

**Obtain an instance ID**

You can obtain the ID of an instance in the cloud service console of the Apsara Uni-manager Management Console. For example, you can view instance IDs in the Elastic Compute Service (ECS) console.

4. On the Instances page, view the instance IDs in the **Instance ID/Name** column of the

### SDK for Java

After you install the Alibaba Cloud Software Development Kit (SDK) for Java, you can use the SDK to access the Alibaba Cloud Portable OpenAPI (POP) gateway and call the API operations of the Unified Cloud Management Platform.

**Prerequisites**

An AccessKey pair or a Security Token Service (STS) AccessKey pair is obtained. For more information, see Obtain AccessKey credentials. Obtain the endpoint of the Unified Cloud Management Platform. For more information, see Obtain the endpoint of the Unified Cloud Management Platform. Java Development Kit (JDK) 1.8 or later is installed.

**Install the SDK for Java**

Add the core library of Alibaba Cloud SDK for Java to the pom.xml file in your Maven project.

```xml
<!-- https://mvnrepository.com/artifact/com.aliyun/aliyun-java-sdk-core --> <dependency>
    <groupId>com.aliyun</groupId>
    <artifactId>aliyun-java-sdk-core</artifactId>
    <version>4.5.30</version>
</dependency>
```

**Note**

Go to the **Developer Portal** > **API Integration** > **API Debugging** page to obtain the latest SDK package dependency. For more information, see Obtain the SDK package for the Unified Cloud Management Platform.

**Create a request named CommonRequest**

CommonRequest supports all API operations.

**Handle errors**

If an error occurs on the server or SDK when you use the SDK for Java, an error response is returned. The error response contains an error code and an error message. In most cases, you do not need to handle the errors returned by the SDK for Java. You need to only handle the errors returned by the server based on error messages. `ServerException` indicates a server-side error. `ClientException` indicates a client-side error. The following error indicates that the AccessKey ID is invalid. You must specify a valid AccessKey ID.

```
com.aliyuncs.exceptions.ClientException: InvalidAccessKeyId.NotFound : Specified access key is not found.
```

###### CreateOrganization

Creates an organization.

**Request headers**

This operation does not have operation-specific request headers and uses only common request headers. For more information, see the "Common request headers" section of the "Common parameters" topic.

**Syntax**

```
POST /ascm/auth/organization/add HTTP/1.1
```

**Request parameters**

| Parameter | Type | Posi tion | Requir ed | Example | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| name | String | Body | Yes | ascm-test | The name of the organization. |
| parentId | Integer | Body | Yes | 1 | The ID of the parent organization. You can call the GetOrganizationList operation to query organization IDs. Note The ID of the root organization is 1. |
| orgParentUuid | String | Body | No | org- 101bbf866a93 0ae6******** | The UUID of the parent organization. |
| orgUuid | String | Body | No | org- 101bbf866a93 0ae6******** | The UUID of the organization. The system automatically generates a value for this parameter. |

| multiCloudStat us | String | Body | No | null | The multi-cloud status of the organization. Default value: null. Valid values: master: The organization is a primary-cloud organization. slave: The organization is a secondary-cloud organization. null: The organization is not a multi-cloud organization. Note This parameter is deprecated. However, this parameter must be retained based on the compatibility requirements. |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| extraInfo | String | Body | No | null | The additional information. |

**Response parameters**

| Parameter | Type | Example | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| code | String | 200 | The HTTP status code. Valid values: 200: The call was successful. 400: The organization name is left empty. The ID of the parent organization is left empty. The parent organization does not exist. The AccessKey pair is invalid. The parameter is invalid. 403: You do not have the required permissions. 500: A remote call error occurred. An internal error occurred. |
| cost | Integer | 10000 | The amount of time consumed by the operation. Unit: millisecond. |

| extraInfo | String | null | The additional information returned. |
| id | Integer | 1 | The organization ID. |
| internal | Boolean | false | Indicates whether the organization is a preset organization. Note The system automatically generates a preset organization. The preset organization is used as the default organization. |
| level | String | 0.1 | The level of the organization. Note The level of the root organization is 0, and the levels of level-1 organizations are 0.1. 1 in 0.1 indicates that the ID of the parent organization of level-1 organizations is 1. In this case, the parent organization is the root organization. All levels follow the same rule. For example, if the ID of a level-1 organization is 3, the level of its sub-organization is 0.1.3. |

###### BindAscmUserAndResourceGroup

Binds users to a resource set.

**Request headers**

This operation does not have operation-specific request headers and uses only common request headers. For more information, see the "Common request headers" section of the "Common parameters" topic.

**Syntax**

```
POST /ascm/auth/resource_group/add_ascm_users HTTP/1.1
```

**Request parameters**

| Parameter | Type | Posi tion | Requir ed | Example | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|

| resource grou _ p id _ | Integer | Body | No | 7 | The ID of the resource set. You can call the ListResourceGroup operation to query resource set IDs. Note If you leave the resource group id and _ _ ascm role id parameters _ _ empty or specify only one of the parameters, an error is reported. |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| ascm user ids _ _ | String | Body | No | "[5017,5023]" | The IDs of the users that you want to bind. Separate multiple user IDs with commas (,). You can call the ListUsers operation to query user IDs. |
| ascm role id _ _ | Integer | Body | No | 1 | The role ID. You can call the ListActiveRoles operation to query role IDs. |

**Response parameters**

| Parameter | Type | Example | Description |
|---|---|---|---|

| code | String | 200 | The HTTP status code. Valid values: 200: The call was successful. 400: The maximum number of users that can be bound to the resource set at a time is exceeded. The maximum number of resource sets to which a user can be bound is exceeded. The parameter is invalid. The operation is not supported by Resource Access Management (RAM)- based batch authorization roles. 403: You do not have the required permissions. You do not have the permissions to manage the resource set. You cannot call the operation for your account. 404: The resource set does not exist. The AccessKey pair does not exist. The user is not assigned the specified role. The user does not exist. The role does not exist. 500: An internal error occurred. 511: The maximum number of users that can be bound to a resource set is exceeded. |
|---|---|---|---|
| cost | Integer | 10000 | The amount of time consumed by the operation. Unit: millisecond. |

| message | String | success | The returned message. Example: success: The request was successful. An internal error occurred. User and resource set must be in the same top organization: The user and the role are not in the same level-1 organization. invalid ascmRoleId or ascmUserId: The ID of the role or user is invalid. the role is not exist: xxx: The role does not exist. |
|---|---|---|---|
| pureListData | Integer | 0 | Indicates whether only data was returned. Note This parameter is deprecated. |
| redirect | Boolean | true | Indicates whether the request was redirected. Valid values: true false |
| success | Boolean | true | Indicates whether the request was successful. Valid values: true false |

**Examples**

Sample requests

```
POST /ascm/auth/resource_group/add_ascm_users HTTP/1.1 Common request parameters
```

`{`

```json
    "ascm_user_ids": "[5017,5023]",
    "resource_group_id": 7
```

`}` Sample success responses `XML` format

```xml
<redirect>true</redirect> <cost>10000</cost> <code>200</code> <success>true</success> <message>success</message>
```

`JSON` format `{`

```json

    "cost": "10000",
    "code": "200",
    "success": "true",
    "message": "success"
```

###### ListMembersInsideResourceSet

Queries users or user groups in a resource set.

**Request headers**

This operation does not have operation-specific request headers and uses only common request headers. For more information, refer to the documentation of common request parameters.

**Syntax**

```
POST /ascm/auth/user/listMembersInsideResourceGroup HTTP/1.1
```

**Request parameters**

| Parameter | Type | Posi tion | Requir ed | Sample value | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|

| resourceSetId | Integer | Body | Yes | 4 | The ID of the resource set. Note |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| currentPage | Integer | Body | No | 1 | The page number. Default value: 1. |
| pageSize | Integer | Body | No | 10 | The number of entries per page. |
| condition | String | Body | No | test | The filter condition. Note The condition parameter specifies that the operation returns users whose names contain the specified string. The value of the condition parameter is not case- sensitive. If you do not specify this parameter, the operation returns all users in the resource set. |

**Response parameters**

| Parameter | Type | Example | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| action | String | ListMembersInside ResourceSet | The operation that was performed. |

| code | String | 200 | The HTTP status code. Valid values: 200: The call was successful. 401: The user is not authenticated. 400: One or more parameters are invalid. 402: The cookie is invalid. 403: The operation is prohibited. Access to a specific resource is prohibited. 404: The resource that you want to access does not exist. 406: The account is not enabled. 409: The resource that you want to save or add already exists. 418: The verification based on a verification code failed. 419: The third-party service authentication failed. 420: The signature verification failed. 421: The certificate verification failed. 425: The service does not exist. 426: The certificate does not exist. 427: The AccessKey pair is valid. However, the user to whom the AccessKey pair belongs cannot perform this operation. 428: The AccessKey pair is invalid, does not exist, or is in an abnormal state. 500: An internal error occurred. This code is returned if an unidentified exception occurred. 511: The parameter value exceeds the defined threshold. 512: The security token issued by STS is invalid. 513: The dependent service is abnormal. |
|---|---|---|---|
| cost | Long | 22 | The amount of time consumed by the operation. Unit: millisecond. |
| data | Array of resourceSetMe mber |   | The users or user groups in the resource set. |

| authorizedAlia s | String | multi-role-user-3 | The alias of the authorized user or user group. Note An authorized user or user group indicates that the user or user group is added to the resource set. If the authorized principal is a user, the value of this parameter is the name of the user. If the authorized principal is a user group, the value of this parameter is the name of the user group. |
|---|---|---|---|
| authorizedId | Integer | 5039 | The ID of the user or user group. Note If the authorized principal is a user, the value of this parameter is the ID of the user. If the authorized principal is a user group, the value of this parameter is the ID of the user group. |

###### ListResourceGroup

Queries a list of resource sets that are visible to your account.

**Request headers**

This operation does not have operation-specific request headers and uses only common request headers. For more information, see the "Common request headers" section of the "Common parameters" topic.

**Syntax**

```
POST /ascm/auth/resource_group/list_resource_group HTTP/1.1
```

**Request parameters**

| Parameter | Type | Posi tion | Requir ed | Example | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| resourceGroup Name | String | Body | No | test | The name of the resource set that you want to query. If you specify only the organizationId parameter, the system returns resource sets that belong to the organization and are visible to your account. If you specify only the resourceGroupName parameter, the system returns resource sets whose names contain the specified value and that are visible to your account. |

###### SetDefaultRole

Specifies a default role for a user. A user can be assigned multiple roles. If a default role is specified for a user, the default role is automatically used when the user logs on to the Apsara Uni-manager Management Console next time. After logon, the user can switch to a different role on the User Information page or the Home page.

**Request headers**

This operation does not have operation-specific request headers and uses only common request headers. For more information, see the "Common request headers" section of the "Common parameters" topic.

**Syntax**

```
POST /ascm/auth/role/setDefaultRole HTTP/1.1
```

**Request parameters**

| Parameter | Type | Posi tion | Requir ed | Example | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|

| loginName | String | Body | No | testu | The logon name of the user. Note If this parameter is left empty, the logon name of the current user is used by default. |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| roleId | Integer | Body | Yes | 2 | The role ID. You can call the ListActiveRoles operation to query role IDs. |

**Response parameters**

| Parameter | Type | Example | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| code | String | 200 | The HTTP status code. Valid values: 200: The call was successful. 403: You do not have the required permissions. 404: The user does not exist. The role does not exist. The role does not belong to your account. 500: An internal error occurred. |
| cost | Integer | 10000 | The amount of time consumed by the operation. Unit: millisecond. |
| message | String | success | The returned message. Valid values: success: The request was successful. Forbidden: You do not have the required permissions. NotExist: The user does not exist. The role does not exist. The role does not belong to your account. InternalServerError: An internal error occurred. |

| pureListData | Boolean | false | Indicates whether only data was returned. Valid values: Note This parameter is deprecated. |
|---|---|---|---|
| redirect | Boolean | false | Indicates whether the request was redirected. Valid values: true false |
| success | Boolean | true | Indicates whether the request was successful. Valid values: true false |

**Examples**

Sample request

```
POST /ascm/auth/role/setDefaultRole HTTP/1.1
```

`{`

```json
    "loginName": "testu",
    "roleId": 2
```

`}` Sample success responses `XML` format

```xml
<redirect>false</redirect> <cost>10000</cost> <code>200</code> <success>true</success> <message>success</message>
```

`JSON` format `{`

```json
    "redirect": false,
    "cost": 10000,
    "code": 200,
    "success": true,
    "message": "success"
```

`}`

###### UpdateRoleInfo

This topic describes the modification of the basic information of a role. This interface is used to modify the basic information of a role in the ASCM system. Role types include custom roles, RAM role authorization, and RAM authorization. For more information about permission policies, see the RAM permission policy section in the Apsara Uni-manager Management Console User Guide.

**Request headers**

The UpdateRoleInfo interface does not have specific request headers and uses only common request headers. For more information, see the documentation of common request parameters.

**Request syntax**

```
POST /ascm/auth/role/updateRoleInfo HTTP/1.1
```

**Request parameters**

| Parameter | Type | Posit ion | Required | Example | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| roleId | Integ er | Body | Required | 1003 | The ID of the role. This parameter is required. |
| newRoleN ame | Strin g | Body | Not required | newtestrole | The new name of the role. You can modify the names of roles of custom roles and RAM authorization roles. You cannot modify the names of roles of RAM role authorization. This parameter is optional. |

| newDescri ption | Strin g | Body | Not required | new test data | The description of the role. The description field can be up to 500 characters in length. This parameter is optional. |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| newAssum eRolePolic yDocumen t | Strin g | Body | Not required | { "Version": "1", "Statement": [{ "Action": "sts:AssumeRole", "Effect": "Allow", "Principal": { "Service": ["dms.aliyuncs.com"], "RAM": ["acs:ram::1371111998** ****:root"] } } ] } | The custom AssumeRolePolicyDocum ent. This parameter is valid only when the role type is RAM role authorization. The JSON string can be up to 2,048 characters in length. This parameter is optional. |
| newAction s | Json | Body | Not required | ["rds:*"] | The list of allowed resource descriptors. This parameter takes effect only when the role type is custom role. The total length of all strings in the list cannot exceed 2,048 characters. This parameter is optional. |
| newNotAct ions | Json | Body | Not required | ["ecs:*"] | The list of denied resource descriptors. This parameter takes effect only when the role type is custom role. The total length of all strings in the list cannot exceed 2,048 characters. This parameter is optional. |

**Response parameters**

| Parameter | Type | Example | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| code | String | 200 | The error code. |
| cost | Integer | 31 | Interface response time. Unit: milliseconds. |
| message | String | success | The alert message. |

| Apsara Uni-manag | er |   | Developer Guide·API referenc |
|---|---|---|---|

| success | Boolean | true | Indicate whether the role is edited. true: successful false: failed |
|---|---|---|---|

###### RemoveRole

The topic describes the deletion of a role. When deleting a role, the operator's current role must be superior to the role being deleted. Role scopes from largest to smallest are: all organizations, the current organization and cascading subordinate organizations, and resource sets. Before deleting RAM role authorizations, you must delete all RAM roles under those authorizations. Before deleting a role, you must detach it from all users and user groups.

**Request headers**

The RemoveRole interface does not have specific request headers and uses only common request headers. For more information, see the documentation of common request parameters.

**Request syntax**

```
POST /ascm/auth/role/removeRole HTTP/1.1
```

**Request parameters**

| Parameter | Type | Posit ion | Required | Example | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| roleName | Strin g | Body | Required | mytestrolenew | The role name. This parameter is required. |

**Response parameters**

| Parameter | Type | Example | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| code | String | 200 | The error code. |
| cost | Integer | 45 | Interface response time. Unit: milliseconds. |
| message | String | success | The alert message. |
| success | Boolean | true | Indicate whether the operation was successful. true: successful false: failed |

**Examples**

Sample for request

```json
POST /ascm/auth/role/removeRole HTTP/1.1 {"roleName":"mytestrolenew"}
```

Sample for successful responses `JSON` format `{`

```json
 "code":"200",
 "cost":45,
 "success":true,
 "message":"success"
```

`}` `XML` format

```xml
<code>200</code> <cost>45</cost> <success>true</success> <message>success</message>
```

###### CreateRole

Creates a role in the Apsara Uni-manager Management Console. You can call the CreateRole operation to create a custom role, a Resource Access Management (RAM) role-based batch authorization role, or a RAM-based batch authorization role. We no longer recommend that you call this operation to create a RAM-based batch authorization role. For more information about RAM policies, see topics related to RAM policies in Apsara Uni-manager Management Console User Guide.

**Request headers**

This operation does not have operation-specific request headers and uses only common request headers. For more information, see the "Common request parameters" section of the Common parameters topic.

**Request syntax**

```
POST /ascm/auth/role/createRole HTTP/1.1
```

**Request parameters**

| Parameter | Type | Loca tion | Required | Example | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| roleName | Strin g | Body | Yes | testrole | The name of the role. The name can be up to 64 characters in length. |

| roleRange | Strin g | Body | No | roleRange.allOrganization s | The management permissions of the role. If you set this parameter to roleRange.rawRamRole, a RAM role-based batch authorization role is to be created. If you set this parameter to a value other than roleRange.rawRamRole, a custom role is to be created. Valid values: roleRange.allOrganizati ons: The role has the management permissions on all organizations. roleRange.orgAndSubO rgs: The role has the management permissions on the current organization and its sub- organizations. roleRange.resourceSet: The role has the management permissions on resource sets. roleRange.rawRamRole : The role has the management permissions of the native RAM role. |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| description | Strin g | Body | No | Test | The description of the role. The description can be up to 500 characters in length. |

| privileges | Json | Body | No | ["PRIG SYS METERING R _ _ _ EAD", "PRIG SYS BILLING CLOU _ _ _ DPRODUCTBILL READ", _ "PRIG SYS BILLING ORGR _ _ _ SBILL READ", _ "PRIG SYS BILLING BILL _ _ _ _ EXPORT", "PRIG SYS BILLING BILL _ _ _ _ MODIFY", "PRIG SYS ORG READ", _ _ _ "PRIG SYS ORG CREATE _ _ _ _ DELETE", "PRIG SYS ORG OPERATE _ _ _ ", "PRIG SYS ROLE READ", _ _ _ "PRIG SYS ROLE CREATE _ _ _ DELETE", _ "PRIG SYS ROLE OPERAT _ _ _ E", "PRIG SYS ROLE LOCK U _ _ _ _ NLOCK", "PRIG SYS ROLE SERVIC _ _ _ E AUTHORIZE"] _ | The system permissions. This parameter takes effect only if you create a custom role. |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| organizatio nVisibility | Strin g | Body | No |   | The sharing scope of the role. Default value: organizationVisibility.glob al. Valid values: organizationVisibility.gl obal: The role is globally shared. organizationVisibility.or ganization: The role is shared within the current organization. organizationVisibility.or gAndSubOrgs: The role is shared with the current organization and its sub- organizations. |

| assumeRol ePolicyDoc ument | Strin g | Body | Yes | { "Version": "1", "Statement": [{ "Action": "sts:AssumeRole", "Effect": "Allow", "Principal": { "Service": ["dms.aliyuncs.com"], "RAM": ["acs:ram::137**********9 72:root"] } } ] } | The trust policy. This parameter is required if you create a RAM role- based batch authorization role. |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| ramPolicyI dList | Json | Body | No | [1] | The IDs of the RAM policies. You can call the CreateRAMPolicy operation to create RAM policies. This parameter is required if you create a RAM role-based batch authorization role or a RAM-based batch authorization role. |

**Response parameters**

| Parameter | Type | Example | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| code | String | 200 | The error code. Valid values: 200: indicates that the call was successful. Other status codes: indicate that the call failed. |
| cost | Integer | 13 | The amount of time consumed by the operation. Unit: milliseconds. |
| message | String | success | The returned message. |
| success | Boolean | true | Indicates whether the call was successful. Valid values: true false |
| data | Struct | - | The details of the role. |
| active | Boolean | true | This parameter is deprecated. The enable parameter indicates whether the role is disabled. |

| arId | String | ar- 102a21cd6f200ad4 1430000s | The UUID of the role. The role UUID instead of the role ID is visible in the Apsara Uni-manager Management Console. |
|---|---|---|---|
| code | String | ROLE TESTROLE b _ _ 1dafc | The code of the role. |
| ctime | Long | 1715077737888 | The time when the role was created. |
| cuserId | String | admin | The name of the user who created the role. |
| default | Boolean | false | Indicates whether the role is a preset role. A preset role is predefined by the system. The role that you create is not a preset role. |
| description | String | Test data | The description of the role. |
| enable | Boolean | true | Indicates whether the role is disabled. |
| id | Integer | 1591 | The role ID. |
| organizationVi sibility | String | organizationVisibili ty.global | The sharing scope of the role. Valid values: organizationVisibility.global: The role is globally shared. organizationVisibility.organization: The role is shared within the current organization. organizationVisibility.orgAndSubOrgs: The role is shared with the current organization and its sub-organizations. |
| ownerOrganiz ationId | Integer | 1 | The ID of the organization to which the role belongs. |

| assumeRolePo licyDocument | String | { \"Version\": \"1\", \"Statement\": [ { \"Action\": \"sts:AssumeRole\", \"Effect\": \"Allow\", \"Principal\": { \"Service\": [ \"rds.aliyuncs.com\ " ], \"RAM\": [ \"acs:ram::196251 5325388485:root\" ] } } ] } | The trust policy. | roleType | String | ROLETYPE ASCM _ | The type of the role. Valid values: ROLETYPE RAM: a RAM-based batch _ authorization role, which is known as a RAM role in earlier versions. ROLETYPE ASCM: a preset role or a _ custom role. ROLETYPE RAMROLEAUTHORIZATION: a _ RAM role-based batch authorization role. |

###### CreateRAMPolicy

Creates a Resource Access Management (RAM) policy. A RAM policy defines a set of permissions that are described based on the policy structure and syntax. You can use RAM policies to describe the authorized resource sets, authorized operation sets, and authorization conditions. For more information about RAM policies, see topics related to RAM policies in Apsara Uni-manager Management Console User Guide.

**Request headers**

This operation does not have operation-specific request headers and uses only common request headers. For more information, see the "Common request parameters" section of the Common parameters topic.

**Request syntax**

```
POST /ascm/auth/role/createRAMPolicy HTTP/1.1
```

**Request parameters**

| Parameter | Type | Loca tion | Required | Example | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| policyNam e | Strin g | Body | Yes | ramtestdata | The name of the RAM policy. The name can be up to 50 characters in length and can contain letters, digits, and hyphens (-). |
| policyDocu ment | Strin g | Body | Yes | { \"Statement\": [ { \"Action\": \"ecs:RebootInstance\", \"Effect\": \"Allow\", \"Resource\": \"*\", \"Condition\": { \"Bool\": { \"acs:MFAPresent\": \"true\" } } } ], \"Version\": \"1\" } | The content of the RAM policy. Specify the policy content based on the policy syntax and structure definition. The content can be up to 4,096 characters in length. |
| description | Strin g | Body | No | Test data | The description of the RAM policy. The description can be up to 100 characters in length. |

| organizatio nVisibility | Strin g | Body | Yes | organizationVisibility.glob al | The sharing scope of the RAM policy. Valid values: organizationVisibility.gl obal: The policy is globally shared. organizationVisibility.or ganization: The policy is shared within the current organization. organizationVisibility.or gAndSubOrgs: The policy is shared with the current organization and its sub-organizations. |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|

**Response parameters**

| Parameter | Type | Example | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| code | String | 200 | The error code. |
| cost | Integer | 55 | The amount of time consumed by the operation. Unit: milliseconds. |
| message | String | success | The returned message. |
| success | Boolean | true | Indicates whether the call was successful. Valid values: true false |
| data | Struct | - | The details of the RAM policy. |
| ctime | Long | 1715152881889 | The time when the RAM policy was created. Specify a UNIX timestamp. |
| id | Integer | 182 | The ID of the RAM policy. |

| policyDocume nt | String | { \"Statement\": [ { \"Action\": \"ecs:RebootInstan ce\", \"Effect\": \"Allow\", \"Resource\": \"*\", \"Condition\": { \"Bool\": { \"acs:MFAPresent\" : \"true\" } } } ], \"Version\": \"1\" } | The content of the RAM policy. |
|---|---|---|---|
| policyName | String | test-ram-policy | The name of the RAM policy. |
| region | String | cn-w***********- d01 | The region ID. |

**Request headers**

This operation does not have operation-specific request headers and uses only common request headers. For more information, see the "Common request parameters" section of the Common parameters topic.

**Request parameters**

ascm 2019-05-10 GetUserInfo

###### ActivateUser

Enables a user. When you call this operation to enable a user, all AccessKey pairs of the user are automatically enabled. Apsara Stack V3.12.0 SP016 and later support this operation. Apsara Stack V3.14.0 SP013 and later support this operation.

**Request headers**

This operation does not have operation-specific request headers and uses only common request headers. For more information, see the "Common request headers" section of the "Common parameters" topic.

**Syntax**

```
POST /ascm/auth/user/activateUser HTTP/1.1
```

**Request parameters**

| Parameter | Type | Posi tion | Requir ed | Example | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| loginName | String | Body | Yes | testuser | The logon name of the user that you want to enable. |

Access to a specific resource is prohibited. 404: The resource that you want to access does not exist. 406: The account is not enabled. 409: The resource that you want to save or add already exists. 418: The verification based on a verification code failed. 419: The third-party service authentication failed. 420: The signature verification failed. 421: The certificate verification failed. 425: The service does not exist. 426: The certificate does not exist. 427: The AccessKey pair is valid. However, the user to whom the AccessKey pair belongs cannot perform this operation. 428: The AccessKey pair is invalid, does not exist, or is in an abnormal state. 500: An internal error occurred. ###### AddUser

Call the AddUser API to create a user.

**Request headers**

This operation uses common request headers only. For more information, see the documentation on common request parameters.

|---|---|---|---|---|---|

###### DeactivateUser

Disables a user. If you disable a user, all AccessKey pairs of the user are automatically disabled. Apsara Stack V3.12.0 SP016 and later support this operation. Apsara Stack V3.14.0 SP013 and later support this operation.

**Request headers**

This operation does not have operation-specific request headers and uses only common request headers. For more information, see the "Common request headers" section of the "Common parameters" topic.

**Syntax**

```
POST /ascm/auth/user/deactivateUser HTTP/1.1
```

**Request parameters**

| Parameter | Type | Posi tion | Requir ed | Example | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| loginName | String | Body | Yes | testuser2022 | The logon name of the user. |

Access to a specific resource is prohibited. 404: The resource that you want to access does not exist. 406: The account is not enabled. 409: The resource that you want to save or add already exists. 418: The verification based on a verification code failed. 419: The third-party service authentication failed. 420: The signature verification failed. 421: The certificate verification failed. 425: The service does not exist. 426: The certificate does not exist. 427: The AccessKey pair is valid. However, the user to whom the AccessKey pair belongs cannot perform this operation. 428: The AccessKey pair is invalid, does not exist, or is in an abnormal state. 500: An internal error occurred. ###### ListAccessKeysForManagedUsers

Queries AccessKey pairs of users that are managed by the user who calls this operation. You can use the ascmUserId, organizationId, and loginName parameters to specify the organization and users that you want to query. If you do not specify the parameters, the AccessKey pairs of all users that are managed by the user who calls this operation is returned. A platform administrator, such as a super administrator, and a resource inspector can query the AccessKey pairs of all users. Other global roles, such as the admin role, can query the AccessKey pairs of users who do not belong to internal organizations. Organization administrators or other roles who have the management permissions on the organization and its sub-organizations can query the AccessKey pairs of users in the current organization and its sub-organizations.

**Request headers**

This operation does not have operation-specific request headers and uses only common request headers. For more information, see the "Common request headers" section of the "Common parameters" topic.

**Syntax**

```
POST /user/accesskey/listAccessKeysForManagedUsers HTTP/1.1
```

**Request parameters**

| Parameter | Type | Posit ion | Required | Example | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| ascmUserI d | Integ er | Body | No | 12 | The user ID. |
| organizatio nId | Integ er | Body | No | 1 | The organization ID. You can call the GetOrganizationList operation to query organization IDs. |

| loginName | Strin g | Body | No | test | The logon name of the user. Fuzzy query is supported. |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| pageNum | Integ er | Body | No | 1 | The page number. Default value: 1. |
| pageSize | Integ er | Body | No | 10 | The number of entries per page. Default value: 10. Maximum value: 100. |

**Response parameters**

| Parameter | Type | Example | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| data | Array | N/A | The returned AccessKey pair information. |
| -accessKeys | Array | N/A | The list of AccessKey pairs that are owned by the current user. |
| --accesskeyId | String | tCr5mJhpjo**** | The AccessKey ID. |
| --createTime | String | 1606675230000 | The time when the AccessKey pair was created. This value is a UNIX timestamp representing the number of milliseconds that have elapsed since January 1, 1970, 00:00:00 UTC. |
| --status | String | Inactive | The status of the AccessKey pair. Valid values: Active Inactive |
| -loginName | String | testuser | The logon name of the user. |
| -primaryKey | String | 25925468**** | The primary key of the Resource Access Management (RAM) user, which is used as the unique identifier of the account. |
| code | String | 200 | The HTTP status code. Valid values: 200: The request was successful. 403: You do not have the required permissions. 500: An internal error occurred. |

| cost | Integer | 188 | The amount of time consumed by the operation. Unit: millisecond. |
|---|---|---|---|
| message | String | success | The returned message. Valid values: success: The request was successful. NoPermission: You do not have the required permissions. InternalError: An internal error occurred. |
| success | Boolean | true | Indicates whether the request was successful. |
| pageInfo | Struct | N/A | The pagination information. |
| -currentPage | Integer | 1 | The page number. |
| -pageSize | Integer | 10 | The number of entries per page. |
| -total | Integer | 1 | The total number of returned entries. |
| -totalPage | Integer | 1 | The total number of returned pages. |

###### DeleteUserAccessKey

Deletes the AccessKey pairs of a user. Make sure that a user has at least one AccessKey in the ACTIVE state after you delete the AccessKey pairs of the user. You can manage the AccessKey pairs of your account. The super administrator can manage the AccessKey pairs of all users. Other global roles such as the admin role can manage the AccessKey pairs of users who do not belong to internal organizations. Organization administrators or other roles who have the management permissions on the organization and its sub-organizations can manage the AccessKey pairs of users in the current organization and its sub-organizations.

###### UpdateUserAccessKeyStatus

Enables or disables a single AccessKey pair. Make sure that at least one AccessKey pair is enabled after you enable or disable a single AccessKey pair. Otherwise, an error is reported for this operation. You can manage the AccessKey pairs of your account. The super administrator can manage the AccessKey pairs of all users. Other global roles such as the admin role can manage the AccessKey pairs of users who do not belong to internal organizations. Organization administrators or other roles who have the management permissions on the organization and its sub-organizations can manage the AccessKey pairs of users in the current organization and its sub-organizations.

###### CreateUserAccessKey

Creates an AccessKey pair for a user. Each user can have up to two AccessKey pairs. You can call the CreateUserAccessKey operation to create an AccessKey pair for your account. An AccessKey ID and an AccessKey secret are returned. The super administrator can create AccessKey pairs for all users and only AccessKey IDs are returned. Other global roles such as the admin role can create AccessKey pairs for users who do not belong to internal organizations. Only AccessKey IDs are returned. Organization administrators or other roles who have the management permissions on the organization and its sub-organizations can create AccessKey pairs for users in the current organization and its sub-organizations. Only AccessKey IDs are returned.

**Request headers**

This operation does not have operation-specific request headers and uses only common request headers. For more information, see the "Common request headers" section of the "Common parameters" topic.

**Syntax**

```
POST /user/accessKey HTTP/1.1
```

**Request parameters**

| Parameter | Type | Posit ion | Required | Example | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|

| loginName | Strin g | Body | No | Test | The username of the user for which you want to create an AccessKey pair. If you do not specify this parameter, an AccessKey pair is created for your account. |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|

**Response parameters**

| Parameter | Type | Example | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| success | Boolean | true | Indicates whether the request was successful. |
| code | String | 200 | The HTTP status code. |
| message | String | success | The returned message. |
| cost | Long | 100 | The amount of time consumed by the operation. Unit: millisecond. |
| data | Struct | - | The information about the created AccessKey pair. |
| -accesskeyId | String | qwe****** | The AccessKey ID. |
| - accesskeySecr et | String | eb2hf****** | The AccessKey secret. |
| -status | String | ACTIVE | The status of the AccessKey pair. Default value: ACTIVE, which indicates that the AccessKey pair is enabled. |
| -ctime | Long | 1715835495000 | The time when the AccssKey pair of the user was created. |

**Examples**

```
POST /user/accessKey HTTP/1.1
```

###### GetRecentAkTrailForUser

Queries the audit logs of AccessKey pairs of a user. You can query the logs of disabled AccessKey pairs. You cannot query the logs of deleted AccessKey pairs. The AccessKey pair logs have a latency of about 1 hour in most cases. By default, logs are stored for only seven days. Exercise caution when you change your AccessKey pair. If you want to save logs for a longer period of time, you must configure log storage settings to store logs in Simple Log Service.

**Request headers**

This operation does not have operation-specific request headers and uses only common request headers. For more information, see the "Common request headers" section of the "Common parameters" topic.

```
GET /user/accessKey/trail HTTP/1.1
```

| pageNum | Integ er | Quer y | No | 1 | The page number. Default value: 1, which indicates that pages start from page 1. |
| pageSize | Integ er | Quer y | No | 20 | The number of entries per page. Default value: 20, which indicates that 20 entries are displayed on each page. |
| startTime | Long | Quer y | No | 1 | The beginning of the time range to query. If this parameter is left empty, data within the previous hour is queried by default. |
| endTime | Long | Quer y | No | 2 | The end of the time range to query. If this parameter is left empty, data within the previous hour is queried by default. |
| queryTrail AccessKey | Strin g | Quer y | Yes | qwertg****** | The AccessKey pair whose audit logs you want to query. |

**Response parameters**

| Parameter | Type | Example | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| success | Boolean | true | Indicates whether the request was successful. |

| message | String | success | The returned message. |
| cost | Long | 100 | The amount of time consumed by the operation. Unit: millisecond. |

| --resourceType | String | ascm.resourceType .ecs instance _ | The resource type. |

###### LockUser

Locks a specific user. After you lock a user, you cannot modify the attributes of the user.

**Request headers**

This operation does not have operation-specific request headers and uses only common request headers. For more information, see the "Common request parameters" section of the "Common parameters" topic.

**Request syntax**


**Request parameters**

| Parame ter | Typ e | Positi on | Require d | Example | Description |

|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| loginNam e | Strin g | Body | No | testuser | The logon name of the user. You need to configure either loginName or id to specify the user that you want to lock. |

###### TransferUser

The TransferUser API allows administrators to transfer users and reassign roles in the Apsara Uni-manager Management Console.

**Request headers**

This operation uses common request headers only. For more information, see the documentation on common request parameters.

**Request syntax**

```
PUT /user/action/transfer HTTP/1.1
```

**Request parameters**

| Parameter | Type | Positio n | Required | Example | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| loginName | Strin g | Body | No | testuser | The login name of the user. |
| organizati onId | Inte ger | Body | No | 1 | The ID of the organization, used to specify the organization scope. Obtain the organization ID by calling the GetOrganizationList API. |
| roleIdList | Rep eatLi st | Body | Yes | {"RoleIdList": [ "5", "6", "8" ]} | The list of role IDs. Obtain the role IDs by calling the ListActiveRoles API. This parameter is optional. The default value is the ID of the resource user role. |

**Response parameters**

| Parameter | Type | Example | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| success | Boolean | true | Indicates whether the API call succeeded: true: succeeded false: failed |

| code | String | ROLE RESOURCE _ _ USER | The code of the user role. The system uses the code to identify the role type and determine whether the role has specific permissions during permission verification. Note: The codes of built-in roles are fixed. The system generates the code for a custom role in the following format: ROLE UPPERCASE ROLE NAME RANDOM _ _ _ _ _ STRING. |
|---|---|---|---|
| errorKey | String | exampleErrKey | The error code. |
| message | String | success | The error message. The system returns this parameter regardless of whether the call succeeded. If the call succeeds, the system returns "success" for successful calls, and a custom error message or an error message from the exception stack for failed calls. |
| cost | Long | 121 | The response time of the API call. Unit: milliseconds. |

**Examples**

Sample requests


###### RelateSystemWithUser

Associates the specified user with an external system.

**Request headers**

This operation does not have operation-specific request headers and uses only common request headers. For more information, see the "Common request parameters" section of the "Common parameters" topic.

**Request syntax**

```
POST /ascm/auth/user/relateSystemWithUser HTTP/1.1
```

**Request parameters**

| Parame ter | Typ e | Positi on | Require d | Example | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|

| Parame ter | Typ e | Positi on | Require d | Example | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| id | Integ er | Body | No | 3 | The ID of the user. You must specify the user that you want to associate with the external system by configuring one of the id and loginName parameters in the request. |
| loginNam e | Strin g | Body | No | testuser | The logon name of the user. You must specify the user that you want to associate with the external system by configuring one of the id and loginName parameters in the request. |
| relativeSy stem | Strin g | Body | No | cmp | The name of the external system with which you want to associate the user. If you do not specify this parameter in a RelateSystemWithUser request, all association records of the user with external systems are cleared. |

**Response parameters**

| Parameter | Type | Example | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| code | String | 200 | The returned HTTP status code. |
| cost | Integer | 1000 | The amount of time consumed by the operation. Unit: milliseconds. |
| message | String | success | The returned message. |
| success | Boolean | true | Indicates whether the request was successful. |

**Examples**

Sample requests

```
POST /ascm/auth/user/relateSystemWithUser HTTP/1.1
```

`{`

```json
    "id":3,
    "relativeSystem": "cmp"
```

`}` Sample success responses `JSON` format `{`

```json
 "code":"200",
 "cost":1000,
 "success":true,
 "message":"success"
```

`}` `XML` format

```xml
<code>200</code> <cost>1000</cost> <success>true</success> <message>success</message>
```

###### RemoveUserByLoginName

Deletes a user. A deleted user becomes a historical user. You can call the RecoverUserByLoginName operation to restore a deleted user.

**Request headers**

This operation does not have operation-specific request headers and uses only common request headers. For more information, see the "Common request headers" section of the "Common parameters" topic.

**Syntax**

```
POST /ascm/auth/user/removeUserByLoginName HTTP/1.1
```

**Request parameters**

| Parameter | Type | Posi tion | Requir ed | Example | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| loginName | String | Body | Yes | testuser2022 | The logon name of the user. The name must be 2 to 64 characters in length and can contain letters, digits, underscores ( ), hyphens _ (-), and periods (.). The logon name identifies the user that you want to delete. |
| multiCloudStat us | String | Body | No | master | The multi-cloud synchronization status of the user. Default value: null. Valid values: master: The user is a primary- cloud user. master: The user is a secondary-cloud user. null: The user is not a multi- cloud user. Note This parameter is deprecated. However, this parameter must be retained based on the compatibility requirements. |

**Response parameters**

| Parameter | Type | Example | Description |
|---|---|---|---|

| code | String | 200 | The HTTP status code. Valid values: 200: The call was successful. 401: The user is not authenticated. 400: One or more parameters are invalid. 402: The cookie is invalid. 403: The operation is prohibited. Access to a specific resource is prohibited. 404: The resource that you want to access does not exist. 406: The account is not enabled. 409: The resource that you want to save or add already exists. 418: The verification based on a verification code failed. 419: The third-party service authentication failed. 420: The signature verification failed. 421: The certificate verification failed. 425: The service does not exist. 426: The certificate does not exist. 427: The AccessKey pair is valid. However, the user to whom the AccessKey pair belongs cannot perform this operation. 428: The AccessKey pair is invalid, does not exist, or is in an abnormal state. 500: An internal error occurred. This code is returned if an unidentified exception occurred. 511: The parameter value exceeds the defined threshold. 512: The security token issued by STS is invalid. 513: The dependent service is abnormal. |
|---|---|---|---|
| cost | Integer | 371 | The amount of time consumed by the operation. Unit: millisecond. |

| message | String | success | The returned message. Note This parameter is returned, regardless of whether the request was successful. If the request was successful, success is returned as the value of this parameter. If the request failed, a custom error message or an error message in the error stack is returned. |
|---|---|---|---|
| pureListData | Boolean | false | Indicates whether only data was returned. Note This parameter is deprecated. |
| redirect | Boolean | false | Indicates whether the request was redirected. Valid values: true false |
| success | Boolean | true | Indicates whether the request was successful. Valid values: true false |

**Examples**

Sample requests

```
POST /ascm/auth/user/removeUserByLoginName HTTP/1.1 Common request parameters
```

`{`

```json
    "loginName":"testuser2022"
```

`}` Sample success responses `XML` format

```xml
<code>200</code> <cost>371</cost> <success>true</success> <message>success</message>
```

`JSON` format `{`

```json
    "code": "200",
    "cost": 371,
    "success": true,
    "message": "success"
```

`}`

| multiCloud Status | Strin g | Body | No | null | The multi-cloud status of the user. Default value: null. This parameter is deprecated. However, this parameter must be retained based on the compatibility requirements. Valid values: master: The user is a primary-cloud user. slave: The user is a secondary-cloud user. null: The user is not a multi-cloud user. |

###### ResetPasswordByLoginName

Resets the password of a user. Only administrators of an organization can reset the password of a user in the organization. You can call the ResetPasswordByLoginName operation to reset the password of a user to a random password. You can perform the following steps to view the random password in the Apsara Uni-manager Management Console: In the top navigation bar, click Enterprise. In the left-side navigation pane, choose Users > Users. On the Users page, find the user whose password you reset and click the username to go to the User Details page. On the User Details, view the password of the user. When the user uses the random password to log on for the first time, the user is required to change the random password. If you use Apsara Stack V3.17.0 or later, we recommend that you use the ResetUserPasswordByLoginName operation instead of the ResetPasswordByLoginName operation.

**Request headers**

This operation does not have operation-specific request headers and uses only common request headers. For more information, see the "Common request headers" section of the "Common parameters" topic.

**Syntax**

```
POST /ascm/auth/user/resetPasswordByLoginName HTTP/1.1
```

**Request parameters**

| Parameter | Type | Posi tion | Requir ed | Example | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| loginName | String | Body | Yes | testu | The logon name of the user. |

**Response parameters**

| Parameter | Type | Example | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| code | String | 200 | The HTTP status code. Valid values: 200: The call was successful. 403: You do not have the required permissions. 404: The user does not exist. 500: An internal error occurred. |
| cost | Integer | 10000 | The amount of time consumed by the operation. Unit: millisecond. |

| message | String | success | The returned message. Valid values: success: The call was successful. Forbidden: You do not have the required permissions. NotExist: The user does not exist. InternalServerError: An internal error occurred. |
|---|---|---|---|
| pureListData | Boolean | false | Indicates whether only data was returned. Note This parameter is deprecated. |
| redirect | Boolean | false | Indicates whether the request was redirected. Valid values: true false |
| success | Boolean | true | Indicates whether the request was successful. Valid values: true false |

**Examples**

Sample requests

```
POST /ascm/auth/user/resetPasswordByLoginName HTTP/1.1 Common request parameters
```

`{`

```json
    "loginName": "testu"
```

`}` Sample success responses `XML` format

```xml
<redirect>false</redirect> <cost>10000</cost> <code>200</code> <success>true</success> <message>success</message>
```

`JSON` format `{`

```json
    "redirect": false,
    "cost": 10000,
    "code": 200,
    "success": true,
    "message": "success"
```

`}`

Access to the resource is denied. 404: The requested resource does not exist. 406: The account is not activated. 409: The data to be saved or added already exists. 418: The verification code is invalid. 419: Authentication with the third-party service failed. 420: The signature verification failed. 421: Certificate verification failed. 425: The service does not exist. 426: The certificate does not exist. 427: The AccessKey is valid, but the user who owns the AccessKey cannot perform this operation. 428: The AccessKey is invalid. POST /ascm/auth/user/updatePassword HTTP/1.1

|---|---|---|---|---|---|

| newPassword | String | Body | Yes | 999999 | The new password of the user. The new password must meet the password policy requirements of the Apsara Uni-manager Management Console. |

**Response parameters**

###### UpdateUserGroup

Update the name and description of a specified user group.

**Request headers**

This operation uses common request headers only. For more information, see the documentation on common request parameters.

**Request syntax**

```
PUT /userGroups/[userGroupId] HTTP/1.1
```

**Request parameters**

| Parameter | Type | Positio n | Required | Example | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| userGroup Id | Integ er | Path | Yes | 123 | The ID of the user group. |
| newGroup Name | String | Body | No | NewTestGroup | A new name representing a team in the work environment, such as "Marketing department" or "Project X team". |
| newDescri ption | String | Body | Yes | This role is for testing | The description, optional, within 100 characters. |

**Response parameters**

| Parameter | Type | Example | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| success | Boolean | true | Indicates whether the API call succeeded. true: succeeded false: failed |

| code | String | ROLE RESOURCE _ _ USER | The code of the user role. The system uses this code during permission verification to determine the role type and check whether the role has the required permissions. Note: The codes of built-in roles are fixed. The system generates the code for a custom role in the format of ROLE UPPERCASE ROLE NAME RANDOM _ _ _ _ _ STRING. |
|---|---|---|---|
| errorKey | String | exampleErrKey | The error code. |
| message | String | success | The error message. The system returns this parameter regardless of whether the request succeeded. The value is "success" for successful requests, and a custom error message or an error message from the exception stack for failed requests. |
| cost | Long | 121 | The response time of the API request. Unit: milliseconds (ms). |
| data | Struct | - | The response result indicating whether the workflow callback succeeded. |
| -id | Integer | 33 | The ID of the role. |
| -groupName | String | testUserGroup01 | The name of the user group. |
| -organizationId | Integer | 3 | The ID of the organization to which the user group belongs. |
| -augId | String | aug- 101de696afc90a42 0d****** | The unique identifier of the user group. |

###### GetUserGroup

Queries the information about a user.

**Request headers**

This operation does not have operation-specific request headers and uses only common request headers. For more information, see the "Common request parameters" section of the Common parameters topic.

**Request syntax**

```
GET /userGroup/get HTTP/1.1
```

**Request parameters**

| Parame ter | Typ e | Locati on | Require d | Example | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| userGroup Id | Integ er | Query | No | 123 | The ID of the user group. |
| augId | Strin g | Query | No | aug- 101de696afc90a420d*** *** | The UUID of the user group. |

At least one of the userGroupId or augId parameter is specified. If both are specified, the augId parameter takes precedence.

**Response parameters**

| Parameter | Type | Example | Description |

| errorKey | String | ascm.auth.InvalidP arameter | The error code. |
| message | String | success | This parameter is returned, regardless of whether the request was successful. Generally, success is returned if the call is successful. If the call fails, a custom error message or an error message in the exception stack is returned. |
| cost | Long | 36 | The amount of time consumed by the operation. Unit: millisecond. |
| data | Struct | - | The response. |
| -id | Integer | 123 | The ID of the user group. |
| -groupName | String | TestGroup | The name of the user group. |
| -organizationId | Integer | 3 | The ID of the organization to which the user group belongs. |

| Parameter | Type | Example | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| - createTimeSta mp | Long | 1606791494471 | The time when the user group was created. |
| -augId | String | aug- 101de696afc90a42 0d****** | The UUID of the user group. |

**Examples**

###### UpdateInstanceBelong

Changes the resource set of an instance. You cannot change the resource set of an instance across level-1 organizations. When you call this operation, the system checks whether the quota limits of resource sets and instances are reached. If so, the error code 510 is returned. The security groups of Elastic Compute Service (ECS) instances and the vSwitches in the virtual private clouds (VPCs) can be changed only within the sharing scope of the VPC to which they belong. If you change the resource set of an ECS instance, the disks, snapshots, and elastic network interfaces (ENIs) of the ECS instance are also changed. If you change the resource set of a VPC, the route tables in the VPC are also changed.

**Request headers**

This operation does not have operation-specific request headers and uses only common request headers. For more information, see the "Common request parameters" section of the Common parameters topic.

**Request syntax**

```
POST /ascm/manage/belong/updateInstance HTTP/1.1
```

**Request parameters**

| Parameter | Type | Posit ion | Required | Example | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| ResourceT ype | Strin g | Body | Yes | ecs instance _ | The resource type. |
| InstanceId | Strin g | Body | Yes | i-0jp******* | The instance ID. |
| RegionNa me | Strin g | Body | Yes | cn-****-d01 | The region ID of the instance. |
| TargetRes ourceSetId | Strin g | Body | No | 2 | The ID of the destination resource set. |

**Response parameters**

| Parameter | Type | Example | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| Success | Boolean | true | Indicates whether the request was successful. Valid values: true false |

| Code | String | 200 | The response code. 200: The request was successful 400: The resource type is invalid. The specified resource set is not found. The specified instance ID is invalid. The top-level organization does not match. Change failed. 403: You do not have permissions. 510: The quota limit is reached. |
|---|---|---|---|
| Message | String | exampleerrmessag e | The response. If the request was successful, a null value is returned. If the request failed, an error message is returned. |
| RequestId | String | 530dxxx-dxx******- x6b61axxxxx | The ID of the request to change the resource set of an instance. |
| ErrorKey | String | exampleErrKey | The error code. |
| Cost | Long | 934 | The amount of time consumed by the operation. Unit: milliseconds. |
| Path | String | examplepath | The request path. |
| Redirect | Boolean | false | Indicates whether the request was redirected. Valid values: true false |
| IsPureListData | Boolean | false | Indicates whether the relevant data was returned. |
| PureListDataSt ring | String | false | The returned data. |

**Examples**

Sample requests

```
POST /ascm/manage/belong/updateInstance HTTP/1.1
```


###### UpdateInstancesBelong

Call the UpdateInstanceBelong API to change the ownership of multiple instances of the same resource type. You cannot change instance ownership across level-1 organizations. The system checks whether the operation exceeds the product quota in the target organization. If the operation exceeds the quota, the system returns an error message with the error code 510. You can change the ownership of ECS security groups and VPC switches only within the sharing scope of their associated VPCs. Changing the ownership of an ECS instance also changes the ownership of the disks, snapshots, and elastic network interfaces under the ECS instance. Changing the ownership of a VPC-connected instance also changes the ownership of the route tables under the VPC.

**Request headers**

This API uses common request headers and has no special request headers. For more information, see the Common Request Parameter document.

**Syntax**

```
POST /belong/updateInstances HTTP/1.1
```

**Request parameters**

| instanceLi st | Strin g | Body | Yes | [{\"instanceId\":\"vpc- 4wqbagxxxx\",\"regionId \":\"cn-wulan-xxxx\"}, {\"instanceId\":\"vpc- 4wq3xxxx\",\"regionId\": \"cn-xxxx\"}] | The list of instances. You must specify this parameter. |
| targetRes ourceSetI d | Strin g | Body | Yes | 1 | The ID of the target resource set. You must specify this parameter. |
| platformC ode | Strin g | Body | No | default | The platform code. Default value: default. |

**Response parameters**

| Parameter | Type | Example | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| Success | Boolean | true | Indicates whether the request was successful. |
| Code | String | 200 | The status code. |
| Message | String | success | The message. |
| RequestId | String | E43F52CE-42B8- 581B-B818- 3C50B276566C | The request ID. |
| ErrorKey | String | error | The error key. |
| Cost | Long | 100 | The execution time. |

| psara Uni-manag | er |   | Developer Guide·API referenc |
|---|---|---|---|

| Parameter | Type | Example | Description |

| IsPureListData | Boolean | false | Indicates whether the response contains pure list data. |
| PureListDataSt ring | String | xxx | The pure list data string. |


###### UpdateOrganizationBelong

###### UpdateResourceSetBelong

Update the ownership of a resource set. You can change ownership only within the same level-1 organization. Do not change ownership across different level-1 organizations. Do not change the ownership of a resource set across different level-1 organizations. The system checks whether the change exceeds the quota for all products in the target organization. If the quota is exceeded, the system returns an error message with error code 510. When you change the ownership of a resource set, the system also changes the ownership of all instances under that resource set.

**Request headers**

This operation uses common request headers only. For more information, see the documentation on common request parameters.

**Request syntax**

```
POST /belong/updateResourceSet HTTP/1.1
```

|---|---|---|---|

| Code | String | 400 | The HTTP status code: 200: The call succeeded. 400: The resource type is invalid. The system cannot find the resource set. The instance ID is invalid. The top-level organization does not match. The change failed. 403: You do not have the required permissions. |

| RequestId | String | 0a1128a91691719 8245846573e0*** | The ID of the request to change the ownership of a resource set. |
| ErrorKey | String | ascm.manage.Inter nalError | The exception status code. This parameter is deprecated. |
| Cost | Long | 100 | The response time of the API request. Unit: milliseconds (ms). If the time from sending a request to receiving a response exceeds 10 seconds when the request passes through the ASAPI gateway, the system considers the request timed out. |

##### AddCommonSpec

##### CreateQuota

Creates a quota.

**Request headers**

This operation does not have operation-specific request headers and uses only common request headers. For more information, see the "Common request parameters" section of the Common parameters topic.

**Request parameters**

| Parameter | Type | Loca tion | Required | Example | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| requestId | Strin g | Syst em | No | d0c6ed24-45af-4703- 866f-5103302b**** | The request ID. |
| productNa me | Strin g | Body | No | ECS | The name of the product. Examples: ECS, OSS, VPC, RDS, SLB, ODPS, EIP, ADB, GPDB, R-KVstore, DRDS, OTS, NAS, and DDS. |

| quotaBody | Json | Body | No | {"totalCpu":100,"totalMe m":100,"totalGpu":100, "totalDisk cloud ssd":100 _ _ ,"totalDisk cloud efficien _ _ cy":100} | The specific quota parameters of the product. |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| quotaType Id | Integ er | Body | No | 1 | If you set a quota for an organization, enter the organization ID. If you set a quota for a resource set, enter the resource set ID. |
| quotaType | Strin g | Body | No | organization | If you create a quota for an organization, enter organization. If you create a quota for a resource set, enter resourceGroup. |
| regionNam e | Strin g | Body | No | cn-****-d01 | The region ID. |
| clusterNa me | Strin g | Body | No | "" | This parameter is a reserved parameter. It indicates the cluster name. You can leave this parameter empty or enter an empty string. |
| targetType | Strin g | Body | No | "" | If the product is RDS, enter the name of the corresponding engine. MySQL and SQLServer are supported. For other products, you can leave this parameter empty or enter an empty string. |
