##### ListEnterpriseCenterQuotas

Queries the quota limits in the enterprise center. The enterprise center allows you to query 12 quota limits. After the call is successful, information about the quota limits and the maximum values of metrics on the cloud platform is returned. MaxResourceSetBindAscmUserLimit: the maximum number of users that can be bound to a resource set. MaxResourceSetBindAscmUserGroupLimit: the maximum number of user groups that can be bound to a resource set. MaxUserGroupCanJoinUserLimit: the maximum number of users that can be added to a user group. MaxUserAddUserGroupLimit: the maximum number of user groups that a user can join. MaxUserAddResourceSetLimit: the maximum number of resource sets to which a userspecified role can be bound. MaxUserGroupAddResourceLimit: the maximum number of resource sets to which a user group can be bound. MaxRoleBindAscmUserLimit: the maximum number of roles that can be bound to a user. MaxRoleAuthorizationBindAscmUserLimit: the maximum number of Resource Access Management (RAM)-based batch authorization roles that can be bound to a user. MaxRoleBindAscmUserGroupLimit: the maximum number of roles that can be bound to a user group. MaxPolicyLimit: the maximum number of custom policies that can be created in an Apsara Stack tenant account. MaxRamGroupLimit: the maximum number of RAM groups that can be created in an Apsara Stack tenant account. MaxRamRoleLimit: the maximum number of RAM roles that can be created per Apsara Stack tenant account.

**Request headers**

This operation does not have operation-specific request headers and uses only common request headers. For more information, see the "Common request parameters" section of the Common parameters topic.

**Request syntax**

```
GET /enterpriseCenter/Quotas HTTP/1.1
```

This operation does not have operation-specific request parameters.

**Response parameters**

| Parameter | Type | Example | Description |
|---|---|---|---|

| data | Array | - | 12 quota limits (EnterpriseCenterQuotaEntry) are returned in a list, which contains the following fields: item: the limit item. current: the actual maximum value of the current item. displayName: the display field. hasDetail: indicates whether details are shown. quota: the quota of the limit item. updateTime: the timestamp of the last update. |
|---|---|---|---|
| -current | Integer | 16 | The actual maximum value of the current item |
| -quota | Integer | 10000 | The quota of the limit item. |
| -displayName | String | The maximum number of users that can be bound to a resource set. | Displays the field. |
| -hasDetail | Boolean | true | Specifies whether to display the details. |
| -item | String | MaxResourceSetBi ndAscmUserLimit | The limit item. |
| -updateTime | Long | 1701932609000 | The time of the last update. The value is a UNIX timestamp. |
| code | String | 200 | The response code. |
| cost | Integer | 150 | The amount of time that is consumed by the operation. Unit: milliseconds. |
| message | String | success | The returned message. |
| success | Boolean | true | Indicates whether the request was successful. |

**Examples**

Sample requests

```
GET /enterpriseCenter/Quotas HTTP/1.1
```

    "cost": 131,

##### GetEnterpriseCenterQuotaDetail

This topic describes the call of the GetEnterpriseCenterQuotaDetail interface to obtain detailed information about users, user groups, resource sets, or Alibaba Cloud accounts that have exceeded the specified Enterprise Center usage limit quotas or specified quantities in the current cloud platform. You can call this interface to query detailed information about users, user groups, resource sets, or Alibaba Cloud accounts that have exceeded the specified Enterprise Center usage limit quotas in the current cloud platform. You can specify a specific quantity in the request to query detailed information about users, user groups, resource sets, or Alibaba Cloud accounts that currently exceed this quantity in the cloud platform to enable early warnings.

**Request headers**

The GetEnterpriseCenterQuotaDetail interface does not have specific request headers and uses only common request headers. For more information, see the documentation of common request parameters.

**Request syntax**

```
GET /enterpriseCenter/Quota/[type] HTTP/1.1
```

**Request parameters**

| Parameter | Type | Positi on | Required | Example | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|

| type | Strin g | Path | Not required | MaxResourc eSetBindAs cmUserLimi t | The quota items in the Enterprise Center usage limit, including: MaxResourceSetBindAscmUserLim it: the maximum number of users that can be associated with a resource set. MaxResourceSetBindAscmUserGro upLimit: the maximum number of user groups that can be associated with a resource set. MaxUserGroupCanJoinUserLimit: the maximum number of users that can be added to a user group. MaxUserAddUserGroupLimit: the maximum number of user groups that a user can join. MaxUserAddResourceSetLimit: the maximum number of resource sets that a user with a specific role can join. MaxUserGroupAddResourceLimit: the maximum number of resource sets to which a user group can join. MaxRoleBindAscmUserLimit: the maximum number of roles that can be associated with a user. MaxRoleAuthorizationBindAscmUs erLimit: the maximum number of RAM authorization roles that can be associated with a user. MaxRoleBindAscmUserGroupLimit: the maximum number of roles that can be associated with a user group. MaxPolicyLimit: the maximum number of custom policies that can be created per Alibaba Cloud account. MaxRamGroupLimit: the maximum number of RAM groups that can be created per Alibaba Cloud account. MaxRamRoleLimit: the maximum number of RAM roles that can be created per Alibaba Cloud account. |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|

| limit | Integ er | Quer y | Not required | 100 | If you specify the quantity of the parameter, it will return the detailed information about the users, user groups, resource sets, or Alibaba Cloud accounts that have exceeded this quantity. If you do not specify this parameter, it will return the detailed information about the users, user groups, resource sets, or Alibaba Cloud accounts that have exceeded the limits of the quota items. |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| currentPag e | Integ er | Quer y | Not required | 1 | You can set the page number of the returned results to display the query results. Default value: 1. It refers to that the display starts from page 1. |
| pageSize | Integ er | Quer y | Not required | 10 | The number of entries to display on each page. Default value: 10. This value indicates that 10 entries are displayed on each page. Maximum value: 500. |

**Response parameters**

| Parameter | Type | Example | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| data | Array | - | According to the specified type parameter, the returned information about users (UserEntry), user groups (UserGroupEntry), resource sets (ResourceSetEntry), or cloud accounts (RamEntry) that meet the query criteria are in a List data format. For more information, see the "Supplementary description for the data parameter" section. |

**Supplementary details**

**Supplementary description for the data parameter**

When the value of the type parameter is MaxUserAddUserGroupLimit, MaxUserAddResourceSetLimit, MaxRoleBindAscmUserLimit, or MaxRoleAuthorizationBindAscmUserLimit, the detailed information about the user (UserEntry) will be returned. The information includes the following fields: id (user ID), username (display name of the user), loginName (login name of the user), isActive (whether the user is enabled), roleId (default role ID), roleName (default role name), count (the current actual quantity or the Enterprise Center usage limit quota item corresponding to the value of the type parameter), and updateTime (timestamp of the last update). When the value of the type parameter is MaxUserGroupCanJoinUserLimit, MaxUserGroupAddResourceLimit, or MaxRoleBindAscmUserGroupLimit, the detailed information about the user group (UserGroupEntry) will be returned. The information includes the following fields: id (user group ID), augId (unique code of the user group), groupName (name of the user group), organizationName (name of the organization to which the user group belongs), count (the current actual quantity or the Enterprise Center usage limit quota item corresponding to the value of the type parameter), and updateTime (timestamp of the last update). When the value of the type parameter is MaxResourceSetBindAscmUserLimit or MaxResourceSetBindAscmUserGroupLimit, the detailed information about the resource set (ResourceSetEntry) will be returned. The information includes the following fields: id (resource set ID), rsId (unique code of the resource set), resourceGroupName (name of the resource set), organizationName (name of the organization to which the resource set belongs), count (the current actual quantity or the Enterprise Center usage limit quota item corresponding to the value of the type parameter), and updateTime (timestamp of the last update). When the value of the type parameter is MaxPolicyLimit, MaxRamGroupLimit, or MaxRamRoleLimit, the detailed information about the Alibaba Cloud account (RamEntry) will be returned. The information includes the following fields: aliyunId (ID of the Alibaba Cloud account), accountKp (primary key of the Alibaba Cloud account), organizationName (name of the organization to which the Alibaba Cloud account belongs), count (the current actual quantity or the Enterprise Center usage limit quota item corresponding to the value of the type parameter), and updateTime (timestamp of the last update). ascm 2019-05-10 GetEnterpriseCenterQuotaDetail

##### AscmExternalFlowCallBack

After a third-party approval is completed, you can call the AscmExternalFlowCallBack interface to notify the ASCM process of the approval result and comments.

**Request headers**

The AscmExternalFlowCallBack interface does not have specific request headers and uses only common request headers. For more information, see the documentation of common request parameters.

**Response parameters**

| Parameter | Type | Example | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| requestId | String | 0a1128a91691719 8245846573e002a | The ID of the request link. |
| success | Boolean | true | Whether the call is successful. true: successful. false: failed. |
| code | String | 200 | The status code. |
| message | String | "success" | The message. |
| data | Boolean | true | The response result: It indicates whether the process callback is successful. |

**Examples**

Sample for request

```
POST /ascm/process/instance/externalFlow/trigger HTTP/1.1
```

`{`

  "callbackParams" : {
    "executionId" : "9647a5eafc9111ef84a502420a881454",

`},`

```

```

##### BillQuery

Call the BillQuery operation to query billing statements for cloud resources.

**Request headers**

This operation uses common request headers only. For more information, see the documentation on common request parameters.

**Request syntax**

```
POST /ascm/billing/billing/web/query/public HTTP/1.1
```

**Request parameters**

| Parameter | Type | Position | Required | Example | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| cycleType | Strin g | Body | Yes | Daily | The type of the billing cycle. The system supports by day (Daily). This parameter is required. |
| groupByT ype | Strin g | Body | Yes | instance | The type of billing aggregation. The system supports aggregation by instance (instance:). This parameter is required. |
| orgId | Strin g | Body | No | 3 | The ID of the organization to which the bill belongs. |
| resourceS etId | Strin g | Body | No | 2 | The ID of the resource set to which the bill belongs. |

| pageSize | Inte ger | Body | No | 10 | The number of entries to return on each page. Default value: 10. Maximum value: 100. |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| billingCycl e | Strin g | Body | Yes | 2023-07 | The billing cycle in YYYY- MM format. This parameter is required if the the type of billing cycle (cycleType) is Monthly. |
| productNa me | Strin g | Body | No | ECS | The name of the product to which the bill belongs. |
| startTime | Strin g | Body | No | 2023-06-30T16:00:00Z | The start time of the billing period. |
| endTime | Strin g | Body | No | 2023-07-31T15:00:00Z | The end time of the billing period. |
| region | Strin g | Body | No | cn-qingdao-***-d01 | The region to which the bill belongs. |
| token | Strin g | Body | No | {"InsId":"i- f9m05tzk3wtss0y8****"," Pos":"Hourly- instance ECS 00000000 _ _ 03 2023-07- _ 21T09:00:00Z","Resourc eGId":"2","RegionId":"cn- qingdao-***-d01"} | The starting position for the query. You must understand OTS query methods to configure this parameter correctly. This parameter takes effect only when the billing data is stored in an OTS database. |

| insId | Strin g | Body | No | i-f9m05j7zfc7b3mhux*** | The ID of the instance to which the bill belongs. Use this parameter to filter bills for a specific instance. |

##### TagResources

Attaches tags to resources.

**Request header**

This operation uses common request headers. For more information, see Common request parameters.

**Request syntax**

```
POST /ascm/manage/tag_manage/tagResources HTTP/1.1
```

**Request parameters**

| Parame ter | Typ e | Locati on | Require d | Example | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| ResourceT ype | Strin g | Body | Yes | ecs instance _ | The resource type. |
| ResourceI d | Repe atList | Body | Yes | i-nn901koe5tx5ei45**** | The ID of the resource to which you want to attach tags. |
| Tag | Repe atList | Body | Yes | - | The list of tags. |
| -Key | Strin g |   | No | testtagk1 | The tag key. The key cannot start with aliyun or acs:, contain http:// or https://, or be an empty string. The key can be up to 128 characters long. |
| -Value | Strin g |   | No | testtagv1 | The tag value. The value cannot contain http:// or https://. It can be an empty string. The value can be up to 128 characters long. |

**Returned data**

| Parameter | Type | Example | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| success | Boolean | true | Indicates whether the operation was successful. true: The operation was successful. false: The operation failed. |

| Parameter | Type | Example | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| code | String | 200 | The status code. |
| message | String | TagResources success. | The returned message. |
| requestId | String | 530dxxx-dxx******- x6b61axxxxx | The request ID. |
| errorKey | String | ascm.auth.Internal Error | The error code. |
| pureListData | Boolean | false | Indicates whether to return only data. |

**Examples**

Example request

```
POST /ascm/manage/tag_manage/tagResources HTTP/1.1
```

`{`

```json
"ResourceType":"ecs_instance", "ResourceId.1":"i-nn901koe5tx5ei45****", "Tag.1.Key":"testtagk1", "Tag.1.Value":"testtagv1",
```

`}` Example response `JSON` format `{`

```json

 "code":"200",
 "success":true,
 "requestId":"530dxxx-dxx******-x6b61axxxxx",
 "pureListData":false,
 "message":"TagResources success."
```

`}` `XML` format

```xml
<errorKey>ascm.auth.InternalError</errorKey> <code>200</code> <success>true</success> <requestId>530dxxx-dxx******-x6b61axxxxx</requestId> <pureListData>false</pureListData> <message>TagResources success.</message>
```

##### UnTagResources

You can call the UnTagResources operation to detach tags from resources.

**Request header**

This operation uses only common request headers. For more information, see Common request parameters.

**Request parameters**

| Parame ter name | Typ e | Positi on | Require d | Example | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|

##### QueryIssueOpenApi

Queries a list of tickets.

**Request headers**

This operation uses common request headers and requires no special request headers. For more information, see Common request parameters.

**Request syntax**

```
POST /issue/queryIssue HTTP/1.1
```

**Request parameters**

| Parame ter | Typ e | Positi on | Require d | Example | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| pageSize | Integ er | Body | No | 10 | The number of entries per page. The default value is 10. The maximum value is 50. |

| Parame ter | Typ e | Positi on | Require d | Example | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| pageNum ber | Integ er | Body | No | 1 | The page number. The value must be greater than or equal to 1. |
| issueId | Integ er | Body | No | ti- 20251110125412674*** | A filter parameter. The business ID of the ticket. This parameter is used for fuzzy searches. |
| issueCate goryId | Integ er | Body | No | 1 | A filter parameter. The ID of the ticket category. |
| modifiedS tartTime | Integ er | Body | No | 2025-11-10T09:49:17Z | A filter parameter. The start of the time range to query based on the modification time. Specify the time in the YYYY-MM- ddTHH:mm:ssZ format. The time must be in UTC. |
| modifiedE ndTime | Integ er | Body | No | 2025-11-10T09:49:17Z | A filter parameter. The end of the time range to query based on the modification time. Specify the time in the YYYY-MM- ddTHH:mm:ssZ format. The time must be in UTC. |
| modifier | Integ er | Body | No | 500 | A filter parameter. The ID of the user who last modified the ticket. |
| finishStart Time | Integ er | Body | No | 2025-11-10T09:49:17Z | A filter parameter. The start of the time range to query based on the completion time. Specify the time in the YYYY- MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ format. The time must be in UTC. |

| Parame ter | Typ e | Positi on | Require d | Example | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| finishEndT ime | Integ er | Body | No | 2025-11-10T09:49:17Z | A filter parameter. The end of the time range to query based on the completion time. Specify the time in the YYYY- MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ format. The time must be in UTC. |
| status | Integ er | Body | No | COMPLETED | A filter parameter. The status code of the ticket. WAIT: The ticket is waiting to be assigned. Withdrawn PROGRESS: The ticket is being processed. FEEDBACK: The ticket is waiting for feedback. Confirmation: Pending COMPLETED: The ticket is completed. PENDING: The ticket is suspended. |
| tab | Integ er | Body | No | TODO | A filter parameter. The type of the list. Currently, only the "TODO" type is supported. |

| -processor | Long | 800 | The ID of the user who processed the ticket. |
| - processorNam e | String | test123 | The name of the user who processed the ticket. |

##### CreateCouponTemplate

Create a coupon template.

**Request headers**

This operation uses common request headers only. For more information, see the documentation on common request parameters.

POST /ascm/trade/coupon/admin/createCouponTemplate HTTP/1.1
```

|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| validFrom Date | Strin g | Body | No | 2026-01-01 | The start time of the validity period for the template. Specify only the date. |
| validToDat e | Strin g | Body | No | 2026-01-31 | The end date of the validity period for the template. Specify only the date. |
| descriptio n | Strin g | Body | No | New user no-threshold coupon | The description of the coupon. |
| denominat ion | Float | Body | No | 100.00 | The face value of each coupon. |
| totalCount | Long | Body | No | 10 | The total number of coupons to issue. |
| resourceM ode | Strin g | Body | No | ALL | The mode for applicable resources: ALL: All resources are available. PART AVAILABLE: _ Some resources are available. PART DISABLE: Some _ resources are unavailable. |

| activeMod e | Strin g | Body | No | IMMEDIATELY | Specifies whether the coupon takes effect immediately or after a delay upon receipt. SAME AS TEMPLATE: _ _ The validity period is the same as that of the template. IMMEDIATELY: The coupon takes effect immediately. DELAY: The coupon takes effect after a specified number of days. FIXED: The coupon takes effect at a specified time. |
| activeDela y | Inte ger | Body | No | 3 | The number of days to delay before the coupon takes effect. |
| activeFro m | Strin g | Body | No | 2026-01-01 | The specified start time when the coupon takes effect. |
| activeTo | Strin g | Body | No | 2026-01-31 | The specified end time when the coupon takes effect. |
| periodAvai lable | Inte ger | Body | No | 10 | The duration of the validity period. |
| ruleDesc | Strin g | Body | Yes | Only new users can use it. | The usage rule of the coupon. |

An API for third-party products to actively push metering data to ASCM in product and commodity management.

This operation uses common request headers only. For more information, see the documentation on common request parameters.

POST /ascm/metering/custom/product/put/metering/data HTTP/1.1

Note: You can push metering data for up to 100 instances in a single request. For each instance, you must push all fields except ResourceGId, ResourceGName, OrgId, OrgName, RegionId, and TableVersion. All instances in the metering data are already managed in resource management. InsId is the instance ID in resource management. StartTime and EndTime must be on the hour, exactly one hour apart, and measured in seconds. All instances in a single request must share the same billing cycle for StartTime and EndTime. |

**Request Headers**

This operation uses only common request headers. No special request headers are required. For more information, see the common request parameters documentation.

```

```

**Request Parameters**

| Parameter | Type | Required | Example | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| sortField | String | No | CreateTime __ __ | The sort field, used for pagination queries. Optional. CreateTime: creation time. |
| nextToken | String | No | *** | Used for cursor- based queries (next page). Provides better performance but does not return the total count. |
| previousToken | String | No | *** | Used for cursor- based queries (previous page). Provides better performance but does not return the total count. |
| orderType | String | No | desc | The sort type. Default value: 'asc'. This parameter takes effect only for pagination queries when the sortField parameter is specified. Ascending order Descending order |
| returnInstanceDe tail | boolean | No | true | Specifies whether to return instance details. Default value: true. Only applicable to the instance query scenario (type=Instance). |

| page | Integer | No | 1 | The page number. A null or value less than 1 indicates a cursor query. Pagination queries have a size limit and can return a maximum of the first 10,000 results. To retrieve all results, use a cursor query (do not pass the page parameter). |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| pageSize | Integer | No | 10 | The number of entries per page. Default value: 10. Maximum value: 1000. |
| groupConfig | json | No | {"groupField":"C ategory","groupD ocsPage":"1","gr oupDocsPageSize ":"10","groupPag e":"1","groupPag eSize":"100"} | groupField: The group field. Valid values: Category, ResourceType, Product, and Type . __ __ groupPage: The group page number. Default value: 1. groupPageSize : The group page size. Default value: 10. groupDocsPag e: The document page number within a group. Default value: 1. groupDocsPag eSize: The document page size within a group. Default value: 100. |

| returnFields | Set | No | [" InstanceId ", __ __ "" InstanceNam __ e "] __ | Specifies the return fields. A null value indicates that all fields are returned. Supported versions: 3.16: 3.16.2 SP015 and later 3.18: 3.18.1 and later |
|---|---|---|---|---|

##### DataCenterStatistics

Data center statistics.

**Request headers**

This operation uses common request headers only. For more information, see the documentation on common request parameters.

**Request syntax**

```
POST /datacenter/action/statistics HTTP/1.1
```

**Request parameters**

| Parameter | Type | Required | Example | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|

| statisticsField | String | No | ResourceType | Default statistical field: ResourceType: resource type Category: category OrganizationId: organization ResourceSetId: resource set RegionId: region Product: code of the backend product Identifier: code of the frontend display product Custom statistical field: user-defined statistical field, such as instance attribute statistics. Aggregation function: used together with statistical fields, such as sum(stroage). The default value is an integer. You can specify the type by using a parameter, such as sum(stroage,float). aggregate: all aggregation information sum: sum avg: average value min: minimum value max: maximum value |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| statisticsFields | Set | No | ["ResourceType" ,"Organization"] | Multi-dimensional statistics. This parameter takes effect only when statisticsField is empty. |
| orderType | String | No | desc | Sorting type. The default value is empty, meaning that the system returns results in natural order without sorting. We recommend that you specify this parameter in pagination scenarios. asc: sorts results in ascending order based on the statistical quantity desc: sorts results in descending order based on the statistical quantity |
| page | Integer | No | 1 | The page number. The default value is empty, which means no pagination and that all results are returned. |

| pageSize | Integer | No | 10 | The number of entries per page. The default value is empty, which means no pagination and all results are returned. |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| timestampSeries | List | No | [165824640000 0,0] | This parameter applies only to sequence-based statistics. The value 0 indicates the current time. The list can contain up to 10 elements. |
| querySeries | QueryS eries | No | {"field":"day", "values":["2022- 07-14", "2022- 08-26"]} | This parameter applies only to sequence-based statistics. |
| groupBy | String | No | OrganizationId | This parameter applies only to grouped statistics. |

##### DescribeInstanceTypeFamilies

Queries instance families provided by Elastic Compute Service (ECS).

**Request header**

This operation uses only common request headers. For more information, see Common request headers.

**Request syntax**

```
POST /ascm/manage/saleconf/ecsSpec/describeInstanceTypeFamilies HTTP/1.1
```

**Request parameters**

| Parameter | Type | Posit ion | Requir ed | Example | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| resourceType | String | Body | No | ECS | The type of the resource. Default value: ECS. |

| status | String | Body | Yes | Available | The status of the resource. Available: enabled Unavailable: disabled |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| groupFiled | String | Body | No | "" | The field used for classification. Note This parameter is deprecated. |
| zoneId | String | Body | Yes | cn-qingdao- ****d01 | The zone ID. |
| deploymentSe tId | String | Body | No | 1 | The deployment set ID. You can call the DescribeDeploymentSets operation of ECS to query the IDs of deployment sets. Note If you specify this parameter, the system filters ECS instance families. If a specific instance family is found in the returned result of the DescribeDeploymentSetSupp ortedInstanceTypeFamily operation of ECS, the returned result of the DescribeInstanceTypeFamilie s operation can contain the instance family. If the instance family is not found in the returned result of the DescribeDeploymentSetSupp ortedInstanceTypeFamily operation, the returned result of the DescribeInstanceTypeFamilie s operation does not contain the instance family. |
| specFrom | String | Body | No | system | The source of the instance specifications. system: The instance specifications are automatically generated by the system. user: The instance specifications are created by users. Note If this parameter is not specified, the default value is system. |

| isReadOnlyRds | String | Body | No | true | Specifies whether to filter read- only RDS instances. Note This parameter is deprecated. |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|

| status | Integer | 200 | The status code returned. Note This parameter is deprecated. |
| success | String | true | Indicates whether the request was successful. true false |

##### DescribeSeriesIdFamilies

Queries instance families of PolarDB-X 1.0.

**Request headers**

This operation does not have operation-specific request headers and uses only common request headers. For more information, see the "Common request parameters" section of the "Common parameters" topic.

**Request syntax**

```
POST /ascm/manage/saleconf/drdsSpec/describeSeriesIdFamilies HTTP/1.1
```

**Request parameters**

| Parameter | Type | Posit ion | Requir ed | Example | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|

| resourceType | String | Body | No | DRDS | The resource type. Set the value to DRDS. Note This parameter is of the enumeration type and is case-sensitive. This parameter must be set to DRDS. If this parameter is set to another value, no data is returned. |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| status | String | Body | No | Available | The status of the instance specifications. Valid values: Available Unavailable If the status of a specification is Unavailable, you cannot create PolarDB-X instances of the specification. |
| label | String | Body | No | true | Specifies whether to return the name of the instance families. Default value: false. Valid values: true false |

**Note**

If none of these parameters are specified, all PolarDB-X 1.0 instance families are returned.

**Response parameters**

**code**: the HTTP status code. Type: string.
200: The request was successful. 500: The request failed.
**data**: the data returned. Type: string.
**creator**: the name of the user who created the instance. Type: string.
**gmtModified**: the time when the instance was created. Type: float.
**seriesName**: the name of the instance family. Type: string.
**modifier**: the user who last modified the instance. Type: string.
**orderBy**: the sorting order. By default, the results are sorted in ascending order by data
ID. This parameter can be ignored. Type: string.
**pageSize**: the number of pages. Type: integer.
**gmtCreate**: the name of the user who created the instance family. This is a virtual
parameter. This parameter can be ignored. Type: string.
**seriesId**: the ID of the instance family. Type: string.
**deleted**: indicates whether the specification is deleted. Type: boolean. Values:
false true
**pageOrder**: the page sorting order. The results are arranged in ascending order. Type:
string.
**isDeleted**: indicates whether the specification is deleted. Type: string. Values: N and Y. N
indicates that the specification is not deleted. Y indicates that the specification is deleted.
**pageSort**: the sorting field. This parameter can be ignored. Type: string.
**pageStart**: the page number. Pages start from 0. Type: integer.
**seriesNameLabel**: the name of the instance family. Type: string.
**resourceType**: the resource type. The value of this parameter is DRDS. Type: string.
**httpOk**: indicates whether an HTTP request is sent. The value of this parameter is false.
Type: boolean.
**success**: indicates whether the request was successful. Type: boolean.
true false
**message**: the message. If the request was successful, the value of this parameter is
describeSeriesIdFamilies success. If the request failed, an error message is returned. Type: string.

**Examples**

Sample requests

POST /ascm/manage/saleconf/drdsSpec/describeSeriesIdFamilies HTTP/1.1 Common request headers

##### CloudSearchResources

This general API searches for hybrid cloud resources. The API performs unified searches for resources across multiple organizations, multi-cloud products, and multiple regions. Only tenant accounts can call this API. Service accounts and primary accounts cannot call this API.

**Request headers**

This API uses common request headers only. This operation uses common request headers only. For more information, see the documentation on common request parameters.

**Request syntax**

```
POST /search/resources HTTP/1.1
```

**Request parameters**

| Parameter | Type | Position | Require d | Example | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|

| organizati onIds | Repe atLis t | Body | No | [3, 5] | The list of organization IDs. When the parameter length is 1, the system considers the organization and its subordinate organizations. Example: [3]. If you want to filter only a specific organization without considering its subordinate organizations, append -1 to the parameter. Example: [3,-1]. When the parameter length is greater than 1 and the format is not [Organization ID, -1], the system considers only the specified organizations and ignores their subordinate organizations. Example: [3,33]. The ID of the root organization is 1. If the input parameters include the root organization, the system ignores other specified organizations. |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| resourceS etIds | Repe atLis t | Body | No | [2, 3] | The list of resource set IDs. If you specify resourceSetIds, the system uses resourceSetIds and ignores organizationIds. |

| regionIds | Repe atLis t | Body | No | ["cn-region- d01","cnregion-02"] | The list of regions. If you do not specify this parameter, the system obtains the region ID from the x- acs-regionid request header. Specify an empty array [] to disable region- based filtering. A unit region can only query data within its own region. In multi-cloud scenarios, you must specify the corresponding platformCode to filter data by secondary cloud region. |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| instanceId | Strin g | Body | No | 123**** | The ID of the instance. The system supports fuzzy search for this parameter. |
| instanceId s | Repe atLis t | Body | No | ["i-lkjl13413","i- fasfd46546"] | The list of instance IDs. The system supports only exact match search for this parameter. |
| instanceN ame | Strin g | Body | No | myinstance | The name of the instance. The system supports fuzzy search for this parameter. |
| instanceIp | Strin g | Body | No | 192.168.**.** | The IP address of the instance. The system supports fuzzy search for this parameter. |
| keyword | Strin g | Body | No | key | The search keyword. The system removes leading and trailing spaces during the actual search. |
| createUser | Strin g | Body | No | testuser | The user who created the resource. |

##### BatchCreateRAMServiceRole

Creates multiple service-linked roles at a time. You can call the ListRAMServiceRoles operation to query the created service-linked roles. A service-linked role is used by a trusted Alibaba Cloud service to access other Alibaba Cloud services or manage resources in other Alibaba Cloud services. If you create an instance of an Alibaba Cloud service that needs access to another Alibaba Cloud service, a service-linked role is automatically created for the service in the level-1 organization of the organization in which you create the instance. For example, an Elastic Compute Service (ECS) instance needs the permissions to create an Object Storage Service (OSS) bucket for image storage. The ECS instance needs to assume the corresponding service-linked role that is provided by OSS. This way, the ECS instance is granted permissions to manage OSS resources.

**Request headers**

This operation does not have operation-specific request headers and uses only common request headers. For more information, see the "Common request headers" section of the "Common parameters" topic.

**Syntax**

```
POST /ascm/auth/ramServiceRole/batchCreateRAMServiceRole HTTP/1.1
```

**Request parameters**

| Parameter | Type | Posi tion | Requir ed | Example | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| organizationId List.N | Repeat List | Body | Yes | ["14","18","19" ,"21","23","24" ] | The organization IDs. Separate multiple organization IDs with commas (,). You can call the GetOrganizationTree operation to query organization IDs. |
| productName | String | Body | Yes | NAS | The name of the service. You can call the ListRAMServiceRoleProducts operation to query service names. |

**Response parameters**

| Parameter | Type | Example | Description |
|---|---|---|---|

| code | String | 200 | The HTTP status code. Valid values: 200: The call was successful. 401: The user is not authenticated. 400: One or more parameters are invalid. 402: The cookie is invalid. 403: The operation is prohibited. Access to a specific resource is prohibited. 404: The resource that you want to access does not exist. 406: The account is not activated. 409: The resource that you want to save or add already exists. 418: The verification based on a verification code failed. 419: The third-party service authentication failed. 420: The signature verification failed. 421: The certificate verification failed. 425: The service does not exist. 426: The certificate does not exist. 427: The AccessKey pair is valid. However, the user to whom the AccessKey pair belongs cannot perform this operation. 428: The AccessKey pair is invalid, does not exist, or is in an abnormal state. 500: An internal error occurred. This code is returned if an unidentified exception occurred. 511: The parameter value exceeds the defined threshold. 512: The security token issued by STS is invalid. 513: The dependent service is abnormal. |
|---|---|---|---|
| cost | Integer | 22 | The amount of time consumed by the operation. Unit: millisecond. |

| message | String | success | The returned message. Note This parameter is returned, regardless of whether the request was successful. If the request was successful, success is returned as the value of this parameter. If the request failed, a custom error message or an error message in the error stack is returned. |
|---|---|---|---|
| pureListData | Boolean | false | Indicates whether only data was returned. Note This parameter is deprecated. |
| redirect | Boolean | false | Indicates whether the request was redirected. Valid values: Note This parameter is deprecated. true false |
| success | Boolean | true | Indicates whether the request was successful. Valid values: true false |

##### GetPasswordPolicy

Queries the password policy that is enabled in the Apsara Uni-manager Management Console.

**Request headers**

This operation does not have operation-specific request headers and uses only common request headers. For more information, see the "Common request headers" section of the "Common parameters" topic.

```

You do not need to specify request parameters for this operation.

| Parameter | Type | Example | Description |

| code | String | 200 | The HTTP status code. Valid values: 200: The call was successful. 500: An internal error occurred. This code is returned if an unidentified exception occurred. |
| cost | Integer | 5 | The amount of time consumed by the operation. Unit: millisecond. |
| data | Struct |   | The password policy data. |

| hardExpiry | Boolean | true | Indicates whether the password has expired. Valid values: true: The password has expired. An expired password cannot be used to log on to the Apsara Uni-manager Management Console. false: The password has not expired. Note The maxPasswordAge parameter indicates the validity period of a password. We recommend that you update your password before it expires. If your password expires, contact the operations manager or platform administrator to reset the password. |
|---|---|---|---|
| maxLoginAtte mps | Integer | 5 | The maximum number of logon attempts with an incorrect password during the password error tolerance period. Note Valid values: 0 to 32. |
| maxPassword Age | Integer | 90 | The validity period of the password. Unit: day. A value of 0 indicates that no password expiration rule is used. Note Valid values: 0 to 1095. |

| passwordError LockPeriod | Integer | 30 | The duration for which the account is frozen. Unit: minutes. Note If the maximum number of failed logon attempts with incorrect passwords is reached, your account is frozen, and you cannot log on with the account within the period. Valid values: 0 to 1440. |
|---|---|---|---|
| passwordError TolerancePerio d | Integer | 60 | The period of time during which the maximum number of failed logon attempts are allowed. The default period of time is 60 minutes. The maxLoginAttemps parameter indicates the allowed maximum number of logon attempts with an incorrect password during the password error tolerance period. |
| passwordReus ePrevention | Integer | 5 | The number of previous passwords that cannot be reused. Default value: 0, which indicates that users can reuse any previous passwords. Note Valid values: 0 to 24. |

| requireNumbe rs | Boolean | true | Indicates whether the password must contain digits. |
| requireSymbol s | Boolean | true | Indicates whether the password must contain special characters. |
| requireUpperc aseCharacters | Boolean | true | Indicates whether the password must contain uppercase letters. |

If the request was successful, success is returned as the value of this parameter. If the request failed, a custom error message or an error message in the error stack is returned. |

##### ListRAMPoliciesForUser

Queries the Resource Access Management (RAM) policies that are attached to users.

**Request headers**

This operation does not have operation-specific request headers and uses only common request headers. For more information, see the "Common request headers" section of the "Common parameters" topic.

**Syntax**

```

```

**Request parameters**

| Parameter | Type | Posi tion | Requir ed | Example | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| loginName | String | Body | Yes | testu | The logon name of the user. You can use the logon name of a user to query the RAM policies that are attached to the user. |

**Response parameters**

**redirect**: indicates whether the request was redirected. The values of this parameter are of
the BOOLEAN type. Valid values: true false
**cost**: the amount of time consumed by the operation. Unit: millisecond. The values of this
parameter are of the STRING type.
**code: the HTTP status code.** The values of this parameter are of the STRING type. Valid
values: 200: The call was successful. 403: You do not have the required permissions. 404: The role does not exist. 500: An internal error occurred.

type.
**description**: the description of the RAM policy. The values of this parameter are of the
STRING type.
**defaultVersion**: the default version of the RAM policy. The values of this parameter are
of the STRING type.
**success**: indicates whether the request was successful. The values of this parameter are of
the BOOLEAN type. Valid values: true false
**message**: the returned message. The values of this parameter are of the STRING type.
Valid values: success: The request was successful. Forbidden: You do not have the required permissions. NotExist: The role does not exist. InternalServerError: An internal error occurred.

##### ResetPasswordPolicy

Resets the current password policy of the Apsara Uni-manager Management Console. After you call this operation, the password policy is reset to the default password policy of the Apsara Uni-manager Management Console. To modify the password policy of the Apsara Unimanager Management Console, call the SetPasswordPolicy operation. For more information about the default password policy of the Apsara Uni-manager Management Console, see the returned data of this operation.

**Request headers**

This operation does not have operation-specific request headers and uses only common request headers. For more information, see the "Common request headers" section of the "Common parameters" topic.

**Syntax**

```
POST /ascm/auth/user/resetPasswordPolicy HTTP/1.1
```

**Request parameters**

You do not need to specify request parameters for this operation.

**Response parameters**

| Parameter | Type | Example | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| code | String | 200 | The HTTP status code. Valid values: 200: The call was successful. 500: An internal error occurred. This code is returned if an unidentified exception occurred. |

| cost | Integer | 14 | The amount of time consumed by the operation. Unit: millisecond. |
|---|---|---|---|
| data | Struct |   | The password policy data. |
| hardExpiry | Boolean | true | Indicates whether the password has expired. Valid values: true: The password has expired. An expired password cannot be used to log on to the Apsara Uni-manager Management Console. false: The password has not expired. Note The maxPasswordAge parameter indicates the validity period of a password. We recommend that you update your password before it expires. If your password expires, contact the operations manager or platform administrator to reset the password. |
| maxLoginAtte mps | Integer | 5 | The maximum number of logon attempts with an incorrect password during the password error tolerance period. Note Valid values: 0 to 32. |
| maxPassword Age | Integer | 90 | The validity period of the password. Unit: day. A value of 0 indicates that no password expiration rule is used. Note Valid values: 0 to 1095. |
| minimumPass wordLength | Integer | 10 | The minimum number of characters in the password. Note Valid values: 8 to 32. |
| passwordError CaptchaTime | Integer | 3 | The maximum number of failed logon attempts with incorrect passwords before human verification (CAPTCHA) appears. |

| passwordError LockPeriod | Integer | 30 | The duration for which the account is frozen. Unit: minutes. Note If the maximum number of failed logon attempts with incorrect passwords is reached, your account is frozen, and you cannot log on with the account within the period. Valid values: 0 to 1440. |
|---|---|---|---|
| passwordError TolerancePerio d | Integer | 5 | The period of time during which the maximum number of failed logon attempts are allowed. The default period of time is 60 minutes. The maxLoginAttemps parameter indicates the allowed maximum number of logon attempts with an incorrect password during the password error tolerance period. |
| passwordReus ePrevention | Integer | 5 | The number of previous passwords that cannot be reused. Default value: 0, which indicates that users can reuse any previous passwords. Note Valid values: 0 to 24. |
| requireLowerc aseCharacters | Boolean | true | Indicates whether the password must contain lowercase letters. |
| requireNumbe rs | Boolean | true | Indicates whether the password must contain digits. |
| requireSymbol s | Boolean | true | Indicates whether the password must contain special characters. |
| requireUpperc aseCharacters | Boolean | true | Indicates whether the password must contain uppercase letters. |

| message | String | success | The returned message. Note This parameter is returned, regardless of whether the request was successful. If the request was successful, success is returned as the value of this parameter. If the request failed, a custom error message or an error message in the error stack is returned. |
|---|---|---|---|
| pureListData | Boolean | false | Indicates whether only data was returned. Note This parameter is deprecated. |
| redirect | Boolean | false | Indicates whether the request was redirected. Valid values: true false Note This parameter is deprecated. |
| success | Boolean | true | Indicates whether the request was successful. Valid values: true false |

**Examples**

Sample requests

```
POST /ascm/auth/user/resetPasswordPolicy HTTP/1.1 Common request parameters
```

`{` `}` Sample success responses `XML` format

```xml
<code>200</code> <cost>14</cost> <data>
    <passwordErrorTolerancePeriod>60</passwordErrorTolerancePeriod>
    <passwordErrorCaptchaTime>3</passwordErrorCaptchaTime>

The default value is [{ "key": "access token", "value": " _ {{access token}}" }]. _ {{accesstoken}} is replaced with _ the obtained access token. This placeholder must be retained. Apsara Uni-manager Management Console uses the key-value pairs in the template as the key-value pairs for the header parameters when requesting the service endpoint for user authentication. |

| Name | Type | Example | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| - UserServiceRe questMethod | String | POST | The endpoint used to retrieve authenticated user information with an AccessToken. GET POST |
| - UserServicePa rameterTempl ate | String | [{"key":"access to _ ken","value":" {{access token}}" _ }] | The parameter template for the API call from ASCM to the IdP to get authenticated user information. For Request type, select GET. The default value for the AccessToken request body template is `[{ "key": "accesstoken", "value": _ " {{accesstoken}}" }]`. This _ template specifies the parsing path for retrieving the authenticated username. For more information, see the Configuration Center section of the Apsara Uni-manager Management Console User Guide. Set the request type to POST: If Content-Type is set to application/json; charset=utf-8, the default value is { "accesstoken": " _ {{accesstoken}}" }. If Content-Type _ is set to application/x-www-form- urlencoded, the default value is [{ "key": "accesstoken", "value": " _ {{accesstoken}}" }]. _ {{accesstoken}} is replaced with _ the obtained access token. This placeholder must be retained. Apsara Uni-manager Management Console uses the key-value pairs in the template as the key-value pairs for the body parameters when requesting the service endpoint for user authentication. |
| - UserServiceCo ntentType | String | application/x-www- form-urlencoded | The Content-Type set in the message header to get authenticated user information using an access token. application/json; charset=utf-8 application/x-www-form-urlencoded |

| Name | Type | Example | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| - UserServiceLo ginNamePath | String | user.name | The parsing path to get the authenticated username. The service that gets user information must return a JSON object. Use a period (.) to indicate the level of the object that contains the username. For example, user indicates that the username is at the first level of the object, and ascm.user indicates that the username is at the second level. |

##### ListAvailablePlatforms

Retrieve the list of resource pools that the current user has permission to view.

**Request headers**

This operation uses common request headers only. For more information, see the documentation on common request parameters.

| includeDef ault | Bool ean | Query | No | true | Specifies whether to return information about the central cloud. Default value: false. false: Do not return the information. true: Return the information. |
| forceInclu deDefault | Bool ean | Query | No | false | Specifies whether to forcibly return information about the central cloud. If you specify a valid sourceOrgId for the central cloud and no other cloud organization is bound, set both includeDefault and forceIncludeDefault to "true" to return the information about the central cloud. |
| platformT ype | Strin g | Query | No | Apsara | The type of the resource pool. The system performs exact match search. Apsara: Apsara Stack ALIYUN: Public Cloud |
| sourceUse rId | Inte ger | Query | No | 123 | The ID of the user in the central cloud. |
| sourceOrg Id | Inte ger | Query | No | 5 | The ID of the organization for query in the central cloud. |

##### ListCloudServices

Retrieve the list of cloud services that Apsara Stack RAM supports.

**Request headers**

This operation uses common request headers only. For more information, see the documentation on common request parameters.

**Request syntax**

```
POST /ascm/auth/role/listCloudServices HTTP/1.1
```

**Response data**

| Parameter | Type | Example | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| data | Array | [ ] | The mapping between cloud service codes and cloud service aliases that Apsara Stack RAM supports. |
| -serviceAlias | String | asr.aliyuncs.com | The alias of the cloud service. |

| -code | String | asr | The code of the cloud service. |
|---|---|---|---|
| code | String | 200 | The HTTP status code. |
| cost | Integer | 121 | The response time of the API call. Unit: milliseconds (ms). |
| eagleEyeTrace Id | String | 0ad40c441762830 7082308977e0*** | The EagleEye ID. It is the unique identifier of the request used to query log information. |
| message | String | success | The prompt message. If the request succeeds, the system returns an empty value. If the request fails, the system returns a specific error message. |
| success | Boolean | true | Indicates whether the API request succeeded: true: succeeded false: failed |
| successRespo nse | Boolean | true | Indicates whether the API returned a success status. |

**Examples**

Sample requests

```
POST /ascm/auth/role/listCloudServices HTTP/1.1
```

#### Parameters related to the

**MeteringQuery operation**

##### Computing

###### Container Registry

After you call the MeteringQuery operation to query statistical data, common response parameters and service-specific response parameters are returned. This topic describes the response parameters specific to Container Registry.

| Parameter | Name | Description |
|---|---|---|
| Pos | Primary key | The primary key consists of the service ID, organization ID, and the beginning of the time range that you want to query. |
| OrgName | Organization name | The name of the organization to which the instance belongs. |
| ResourceGId | Resource set ID | The ID of the resource set to which the instance belongs. |
| ResourceGName | Resource set name | The name of the resource set to which the instance belongs. |
| InsId | Instance ID | The instance ID. |
| RegionId | Region ID | The region ID. |
| StartTime | Start time | The beginning of the time range queried. The time is displayed in UTC. |
| EndTime | End time | The end of the time range queried. The time is displayed in UTC. |
| CreateTime | Instance creation time | The time when the instance was created. |
| repoName | Repository name | The repository name. The name must be 1 to 64 characters in length, and can contain lowercase letters, digits, hyphens (-), and underscores ( ). _ It cannot start with a hyphen (-) or an underscore ( ). _ |
| repoNamespace | Namespace | The namespace to which the repository belongs. The name of the namespace must be 2 to 30 characters in length, and can contain lowercase letters, digits, hyphens (-), and underscores ( ). _ It cannot start with a hyphen (-) or an underscore ( ). _ |
| repoStatus | Repository status | The status of the repository. Valid values: NORMAL: The repository is normal. DELETING: The repository is being deleted. DELETED: The repository was deleted. |

| repoType | Repository type | The type of the repository. Valid values: PUBLIC. PRIVATE. |
|---|---|---|
| repoAuthorizeType | Repository permission | The type of the permission that is granted to the repository. |
| repoBuildType | Build type | Indicates how the repository was built. Valid values: AUTO: The repository was automatically built. MANUAL: The repository was manually built. |

###### ACK

After you call the MeteringQuery operation to query statistical data, common response parameters and service-specific response parameters are returned. This topic describes the response parameters specific to Container Service for Kubernetes (ACK).

| Parameter | Name | Description |
|---|---|---|
| Pos | Primary key | The primary key consists of the service ID, organization ID, and the beginning of the time range that you want to query. |
| OrgName | Organization name | The name of the organization to which the ACK cluster belongs. |
| ResourceGId | Resource set ID | The ID of the resource set to which the ACK cluster belongs. |
| ResourceGName | Resource set name | The name of the resource set to which the ACK cluster belongs. |
| InsId | Cluster ID | The ACK cluster ID. |
| RegionId | Region ID | The region ID. |
| StartTime | Start time | The beginning of the time range queried. The time is displayed in UTC. |
| EndTime | End time | The end of the time range queried. The time is displayed in UTC. |

| CreateTime | Cluster creation time | The time when the ACK cluster was created. |
|---|---|---|
| name | Cluster name | The ACK cluster name. The name can contain only letters, digits, and hyphens (-). It must be 1 to 63 characters in length. It cannot start with a hyphens (-). |
| profile | Cluster edition | The edition of the cluster. Valid values: Edge: an ACK edge cluster. Default: an ACK cluster other than an ACK edge cluster. |
| state | Cluster status | The status of the cluster. Valid values: initial: The cluster is being created. failed: The cluster failed to be created. running: The cluster is running. updating: The cluster is being upgraded. updating failed: The cluster failed to be _ updated. scaling: The cluster is being scaled. stopped: The cluster is stopped. deleting: The cluster is being deleted. deleted: The cluster was deleted. delete failed: The cluster failed to be deleted. _ |
| cluster type _ | Cluster type | The type of the cluster. Valid values: Kubernetes: an ACK dedicated cluster. ManagedKubernetes: an ACK managed cluster. Ask: a serverless Kubernetes (ASK) cluster. ExternalKubernetes: an external cluster that is registered to ACK. |
| current version _ | Current version | The Kubernetes version of the cluster. |
| docker version _ | Docker version | The Docker version that is used by the cluster. |
| size | Number of nodes | The number of nodes in the cluster. Master nodes and worker nodes are included. |

| network mode _ | Network type | The network type of the cluster. Valid values: classic: classic network. vpc: virtual private cloud (VPC). overlay: overlay network. calico: network powered by Calico. |
|---|---|---|
| zone id _ | Zone ID | The zone ID. |
| security group id _ _ | Security group ID | The ID of the security group to which the cluster belongs. |
| vpc id _ | VPC ID | The ID of the VPC in which the cluster is deployed. |
| vswitch id _ | vSwitch ID | The ID of the vSwitch in which the cluster is deployed. You can select one to three vSwitches when you create a cluster. We recommend that you select vSwitches in different zones to ensure high availability. Separate multiple vSwitch IDs with commas (,). |
| private zone _ | Alibaba Cloud DNS PrivateZone | Indicates whether Alibaba Cloud DNS PrivateZone is enabled. Valid values: true: Alibaba Cloud DNS PrivateZone is enabled. false: Alibaba Cloud DNS PrivateZone is disabled. |
| deletion protection _ | Deletion protection | Indicates whether the deletion protection feature is enabled. Valid values: true: The deletion protection feature is enabled for the cluster. This way, the cluster cannot be deleted in the ACK console or by calling API operations. false: The deletion protection feature is disabled for the cluster. This way, the cluster can be deleted in the ACK console or by calling API operations. |

## STS API reference

### Obtaining the endpoint of

**STS.**

To use the POP gateway to call API operations, you must use the service endpoints. You can perform the following operations to obtain an endpoint.

**Procedure**

1. Log on to the Apsara Uni-manager Management Console.
2. In the top navigation bar, choose **Products** > **Development Tools** > **API & SDK** >
**OpenAPI Explorer**.
3. On the **Home** tab, click the **API Integration** tab and click **View Cloud Service Endpoint**.
4. On the **Service Endpoint**page, select**Apsara Uni-manager**from the**Service**drop-down
list to obtain the STS endpoint.

### AssumeRole

Obtains a Security Token Service (STS) token to assume a Resource Access Management (RAM) role.

**Request header**

ce This operation does not have operation-specific request headers and uses only common request headers. For more information, see the "Common request headers" topic.

**Request parameters**

| Parameter | Type | Loca tion | Required | Example | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| DurationSe conds | Long | Quer y | No | 3600 | The validity period of the STS token. Unit: seconds. Minimum value: 900. Maximum value: the value of the MaxSessionDuration parameter. Default value: 3600. |
| Policy | Strin g | Quer y | No | {"Statement": [{"Action": ["*"],"Effect": "Allow","Resource": ["*"]}],"Version":"1"} | The policy that specifies the permissions of the returned STS token. This allows you to implement more fine-grained access control. The following descriptions provide the details: If you specify this parameter, the permissions that are granted to the STS token are the intersection of the RAM role permissions and the permissions that are specified in this parameter. If you do not specify this parameter, the STS token has all permissions of the RAM role. The value of the parameter must be 1 to 1,024 characters in length. |
| RoleArn | Strin g | Quer y | Yes | acs:ram::123456789012* ***:role/adminrole | The Alibaba Cloud Resource Name (ARN) of the RAM role. The trusted entity of the RAM role is an Alibaba Cloud account. For more information, see Create a RAM role for a trusted Alibaba Cloud account or CreateRole. Format: acs:ram:: <account id>:role/<role _ _ name>. |

ce

| RoleSessio nName | Strin g | Quer y | Yes | alice | The name of the role session. Set this parameter based on your business requirements. In most cases, you can set this parameter to the identity of the API caller. For example, you can specify a username. In ActionTrail logs, you can use the RoleSessionName value to distinguish different users who assume the same RAM role to perform operations. This way, you can perform user-specific auditing. The value must be 2 to 64 characters in length and can contain letters, digits, and the following special characters: .@- . _ |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|

**Response parameters**

| Parameter | Type | Example | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| RequestId | String | 6894B13B-6D71- 4EF5-88FA- F32781734A7F | The request ID. |
| Credentials | Struct |   | The access credentials. |
| -SecurityToken | String | ******** | The STS token. Note: Alibaba Cloud STS does not impose limits on the length of STS tokens. We recommend that you do not specify a maximum length for an STS token. |

## Unified Cloud Management

**Platform Integration**

This topic describes the background and value of integrating with the unified cloud management platform.

**Background**

Many users of Apsara Stack require self-service operations and maintenance (O&M) and management capabilities. To bundle business features, they often build or purchase thirdparty consoles that run on top of the unified cloud management platform. To simplify this process, we provide a standard integration solution that helps customers and third-party developers quickly integrate with the Apsara Stack console.

**Value**

This solution enables rapid integration with the features of the unified cloud management platform console, which simplifies third-party console development.

### Operation flow

This topic describes the overall process for integrating the Unified Cloud Management Platform.

**Overall flow**

| Integrating identity verification |   | Page integration configuration |   | Page URL embedding |
|---|---|---|---|---|

[Third-party] [Unified Cloud Management Platform] Logon integration with Enable integration Embedded page URL switch Unified Cloud Management Platform Application information Complete integration configuration Appearance configuration Product channel link configuration
1. Set up identity verification. Use the Single Sign-On (SSO) feature of the Unified Cloud
Management Platform to connect your application with the target Apsara Stack Unified Cloud Management Platform. This allows users to switch between platforms without needing to log on again. For more information, see Set up identity verification.
2. Configure page integration. Use the page configuration options in the Unified Cloud
Management Platform to modify the skin, theme color, and language. This aligns the pages with the third-party management console where they will be embedded, ensuring a consistent user experience. For more information, see Configure page integration. anagement Platform Integration
3. Embed page URLs. After finishing the page configuration, obtain the URL for each page
from the open pages list. Embed the URLs in the target management platform using an iframe to complete the page embedding. For more information, see Embed page URLs.

#### Identity verification integration

This topic describes how to integrate identity verification.

**Required features**

To allow users to log on to the unified cloud management platform directly with their integrator accounts, implement the following features: Organization and user synchronization: Create organizations and users on the unified cloud management platform that correspond to the levels in the integrator’s multi-level account system. Single sign-on (SSO): Maintain the mapping from integrator accounts to users on the unified cloud management platform. Support the identity provider (IdP) feature to respond to SSO requests from the platform or initiate SSO to log on to the mapped platform users.

**Implementation methods**

**Method 1: Purchase IDaaS on-premises**

If you purchase IDaaS for on-premises deployment, use the standard IDaaS solution to synchronize the on-premises account system to IDaaS. No additional development is required.

**Method 2: No on-premises IDaaS**

If you do not have IDaaS, develop your own solution to implement organization and user synchronization and single sign-on (SSO) capabilities.
1. Organization and user synchronization
Integrator’s tasks: Manage the lifecycle of organizations and users on the unified cloud management platform. The unified cloud management platform provides API support. Unified cloud management platform support: The platform provides OpenAPI for creating, reading, updating, and deleting (CRUD) users and organizations. For more information, see the Enterprise Center chapter of the Unified Cloud Management Platform Developer Guide for the corresponding version.
2. Single sign-on
Integrator’s tasks: Maintain the mapping from the integrator’s organization users to the platform’s organization users. Provide an identity provider (IdP) to handle SSO interactions with the service provider (SP) on the unified cloud management platform. Unified cloud management platform support: The unified cloud management platform acts as a service provider (SP) and supports the SAML 2.0 and OAuth 2.0 SSO protocols. For more information, see the “Third-party Authentication” chapter of the Unified Cloud Management Platform User Guide. anagement Platform Integration Obtain the **SP metadata** Obtain the **SAML** In the enterprise IdP,

#### Page Integration Configuration

This topic describes how to configure page integration.

**Configure the Page Entry Point**

To enable page integration for the Unified Cloud Management Platform, go to **Products** >
**Developer Tools** > **Developer Portal** > **Page Integration** and select **Page Exposure**
**Configuration**.

**Important**

Only operations administrators and platform administrators have this permission. Developer Portal anagement Platform Integration Page Integration Page Exposure Settings

**Global Page Integration Toggle**

You can turn on the global page integration toggle to allow the Unified Cloud Management Platform to support integration, such as embedding via an iframe. The platform uses the state of this toggle to control business logic. anagement Platform Integration

**Left-Side Navigation Pane**

You can hide the navigation pane on the left in integrated scenarios. The toggle to show or hide this pane appears only after you enable the global page integration toggle.

**Toggle Settings**

**Preview**

When you enable the Hide Left-Side Navigation Pane option, the result is as follows:

**Page Style Configuration**

anagement Platform Integration The style settings apply to the Unified Cloud Management Platform whether it is accessed directly or through an integrated scenario. Platform language: Choose **Simplified Chinese**, **Traditional Chinese**, or **English** as the default platform language. Skin and theme: Choose **Light Mode** or **Dark Mode**. Pick a recommended theme color or define a custom palette. Page watermark: Enable or disable the page watermark. If enabled, you can enter custom text for the watermark.

**Custom Resource Links**

For example, you can set the URL of the Elastic Compute Service (ECS) Create Instance button to a custom link. When the button is clicked, the configured link opens.

**Configuration Entry Point**

#### Page URL Embedding

This topic describes page URL embedding.

**Page Components**

The unified cloud management platform page consists of a top navigation bar, a left navigation pane, a main content area for displaying business content, and a floating button in the lower-right corner.

**Page Integration Example**

The Independent Software Vendor (ISV) embeds the unified cloud management platform code as follows:

```
<iframe src="https://one.console.inter.***.com/ecs/console/instance? organizationId=1&regionId=cn-***-d01" scrolling="no" frameborder="0" style="width: 100% ; height:500px;">
  </iframe>
```

anagement Platform Integration For example: `<iframe src="URL of the page to be integrated"></iframe>`.

**Concealed ceiling installation**

In integration scenarios, third parties typically use their own top navigation pages. Therefore, the platform's top navigation bar is automatically hidden. In integration scenarios, the ceiling is concealed, and the concealment effect is shown below: The top navigation bar provides capabilities such as switching organizations, regions, and resource groups. You can implement these capabilities in two steps:
1. Retrieve the parameter list by calling an API.
2. Add the corresponding parameters to the integration link URL.

**Switch Organization**

1. Call GetOrganizationList to obtain the list of sub-organizations for a specified organization.
2. Add the organizationId parameter to the integration link. For example:
https://one.console.***.com/ecs/console/home?organizationId=3

**Switch Resource Group**

1. To obtain the list of resource groups in your organization, call ListResourceGroupByOrgId.
2. Add the resourceGroupId parameter to the integration link. For example:
https://one.console.***.com/ecs/console/home?&resourceGroupId=58

**Switch Region**

Add the regionId parameter to the integration link to switch the region. For example: https://one.console.***.com/ecs/console/home?regionId=cn-***-d01

**Switch Multicloud**

1. Call the ListAvailablePlatforms API to obtain the list of multicloud platforms that the current
user has permission to view.
2. Append the `AscmPlatformCode` and `aliyun_mcm_cloud_type` parameters to the
integration link to specify the cloud platform. For example: https://one.console.***.com/ess/console/dashboard?organizationId=3&regionId=cn-***d01&AscmPlatformCode=default&aliyun_mcm_cloud_type=Apsara anagement Platform Integration The `AscmPlatformCode` and `aliyun_mcm_cloud_type` parameters are described as follows: `AscmPlatformCode`: The cloud platform code. Primary cloud: `default`. From the cloud (the format is the same for public cloud and Apsara Stack): pl-xxxxxx. `aliyun_mcm_cloud_type`: The cloud platform type, which can be Apsara Stack or public cloud. Apsara Stack: `Apsara`. Public cloud: `ALIYUN`.

**Help Documentation**

In integrated scenarios, the "Learn More" link is hidden. ISVs must provide their own help documentation for users.

**Open New Page for Links within Iframe Area**

By default, all links within an iframe refresh only within the iframe area and do not open a new tab. If you want a custom link to open in a new tab, add the `target=_blank` parameter to the link. For example, change the configured link to: https://one.console.***.com/ascm/buy? product=vpc&target=_blank

**Monitor URL Link Changes within Iframe**

When you integrate the unified cloud management platform using an iframe, a `postMessage` is sent whenever an internal link changes. You can listen for this message to perform business processing, such as highlighting a menu item in the left navigation pane. `postMessage` format: anagement Platform Integration

```
//biz-nav-console:pathname-change is the type broadcast by the unified cloud management platform window.addEventListener('message', function (event) {
  if (event.data.type === 'biz-nav-console:pathname-change') {
    console.log('Received message:', event.data);
```

`}`

}); //Definition of event.data interface IEventData {
  type: string;
  pathname: string; // location.pathname
  search: string;   // location.search
```

`}`

**Business Page Integration**

When you integrate business pages, the integration link must include the required parameter `outerAscmEmbed=true`.

**Get Target Page Link**

Go to the unified cloud management platform. Open the page that you want to embed, such as the Elastic Compute Service (ECS) instance list. Copy the URL from the browser's address bar. For example: https://one.console.***.com/ecs/console/instance

**Add Embedding Parameters**

The integration link must include the required parameter `outerAscmEmbed=true`. For example: https://one.console.***.com/ecs/console/instance?outerAscmEmbed=true

**Embed Iframe in ISV System**

```xml
<div class="cloud-console-wrapper">
  <h2>My Elastic Compute Service</h2>
  <iframe
    src="https://one.console.***.com/ecs/console/instance?outerAscmEmbed=true"
    width="100%"
    height="800"
    frameborder="0"
    sandbox="allow-same-origin allow-scripts allow-forms"
    loading="lazy">
  </iframe>
</div>
```

**Hybrid Cloud Product Resource Integration**

**Link Parameters**

Links for public cloud product integration require the `AscmPlatformCode` and `aliyun_mcm_cloud_type` parameters to identify the product. Add these two parameters to the integration URL. anagement Platform Integration `AscmPlatformCode`: The cloud platform code. For a secondary cloud (public cloud or Apsara Stack), the format is `pl-xxxxxx`. `aliyun_mcm_cloud_type`: The cloud platform type. For a public cloud, the value is `ALIYUN`.

**Custom Operation Links**

Go to **Page Integration** > **Page Open Configuration** > **Embedded Page List**
**Configuration**. Find the "Alibaba Cloud Public Cloud" type to view the products and
operation links that support custom operation links.

**Management**

Click **Edit** in the **Operation** column for the product link ID. Enter the target address in the
**Modify Link** dialog box. To open a new link, add the `target=_blank` parameter. To add an

**Security Product Integration**

The Security Console is a redirection console and has the following unique characteristics:
1. The console has a separate domain name, which you can obtain from the menu.
2. To use security products, you must switch to a specific role.

**Hide the navigation pane on the left**

To hide the left navigation pane, add the `hideSidebar` parameter to the integration URL and set its value to `true`.

**Security Product Integration Page**

Security products use the `p` and `identifier` URL parameters to locate specific products. For example, the integration page link `https://yundun.console.***.com/? p=soar&identifier=soar&outerAscmEmbed=true` indicates that the integrated product is Security Orchestration Automation and Response (SOAR). For other products, refer to the menu configuration.

**Role Switching**

Request method: GET You can call the oneConsole address. Path: /data/redirect.json Parameters:

| product | identityService | Fixed |
|---|---|---|
| action | switchRole | Fixed |
| version | 2019-05-10 | Fixed |
| params | {"arId":"ar- 9999999***","targetUrl":" https://one.console.***.co m"} | JSON format. `arId` is the `arId` field in the role. `targetUrl` is the redirect address after successful role switching. |

You can obtain the `arId` in the unified cloud management platform by navigating to
**Enterprise** > **Permission Management** > **Role Authorization**.
Example call:

```
https://one.console.***.com/data/redirect.json? product=identityService&action=switchRole&version=2019-05- 10&params=%7B%22arId%22%3A%22ar- 9999999***%22%2C%22targetUrl%22%3A%22https%3A%2F%2Fone.console.***.com%22%7D
```

The `params` parameter is as follows:

```json
{"arId":"ar-9999999***","targetUrl":"https://one.console.***.com"}
```

### API integration

API integration is currently implemented through the POP SDK, which calls OpenAPI interfaces. When you call OpenAPI interfaces, you must use an AccessKey and a SecretKey to represent your identity.

**Obtain your AccessKey ID and AccessKey secret**

1. Log on to the Unified Cloud Management Platform.
2. In the upper-right corner of the page, click your profile picture.
3. Click **Personal information**.
4. In the **AccessKey** section, you can view your AccessKey ID and AccessKey secret.

**Best practices for managing your AccessKey ID and AccessKey**

**secret**

**Use only the AccessKey ID and AccessKey secret of an**

**operations administrator**

When you use this method, Independent Software Vendors (ISVs) must filter and display user data. An operations administrator retrieves data from a global perspective. To display only data visible to a specific user and role, the ISV must filter and assemble the data based on the API operation and the user-role combination. You cannot call workflow approval-related API operations with the operations administrator identity. A few other API operations do not support calls from the operations administrator identity.

**Maintain and use both the operations administrator’s and all**

**managed users’ AccessKey IDs and AccessKey secrets**

The ISV initializes and manages user roles and organization resource set lifecycles. The ISV also stores the AccessKey ID and AccessKey secret for every user. You must perform this step with the operations administrator identity. After you create a user successfully, use that user’s AccessKey ID and AccessKey secret to call related API operations. When you use this method, you can manage the lifecycle of each user’s AccessKey ID and AccessKey secret. Keep them synchronized with the Unified Cloud Management Platform.
